title: Photo Editor — Lightroom (Wedding Galleries)
description:
Moody Imagery is an Australian wedding studio. We're looking for a detail-obsessed photo editor to help us finish our wedding galleries in Adobe Lightroom. This is refinement work, not editing from scratch — every image will already have our preset applied and you'll receive edited sneak peeks to match, so your job is to make each gallery clean, consistent, and polished.



What you'll do



Working from a culled Lightroom catalog (roughly 600–1,000 images per wedding), with our edited sneak peeks as your reference for the look:



Remove distractions (stray objects, exit signs, bins, photobombers, anything that pulls the eye)

Correct composition where needed — crops, straightening, clean framing

Minor blemish removal where needed (skin, spots, small imperfections)

Create a few black & white duplicates where it's creatively appropriate

Keep every image consistent with our sneak-peek reference and preset



Who you are



Highly proficient in Adobe Lightroom (Classic), comfortable with its healing / remove / distraction tools

Photoshop skills a strong plus for trickier distraction removal

Exceptional attention to detail — this is the single most important trait. You notice the small stuff other people miss.

Consistent — you can match a reference look across hundreds of images without drifting

Reliable with deadlines and clear in written English

Fast, stable internet for transferring large catalogs



What this is NOT: This isn't colour grading or building a look from scratch — our preset and sneak peeks set the style. It's about executing that style flawlessly and cleaning every frame with care.



Rate & volume



Per-image rate (guide: around $0.25 AUD per image, ~600–1,000 images per gallery), paid per project. Ongoing work for the right person as our film and photo volume grows.

title: Wedding Video Editor
description:
Wedding Film Editor - Freelance (Long-Term)

Sydney-based brand | Remote



Hi, I’m Jas, founder of Moody Imagery - a Sydney-based wedding photo + film studio creating emotionally driven, cinematic wedding films with a nostalgic, film-inspired aesthetic.



I’m looking for a skilled Video Editor to join my team on a long-term freelance basis, supporting the storytelling side of the business as we grow.This role is for someone who loves narrative editing, emotional pacing, and the art of turning real 
nts into films that actually feel something.



The Role:

You will be editing story-led wedding films that prioritise connection over trend, and emotion over effect.



Your work will focus on:

3–6 minute cinematic highlight films

Full ceremony and speech edits

Documentary-style long-form wedding films

Nostalgic b-roll including Super 8mm and camcorder footage



You’re a great fit if you:

Are confident editing in DaVinci Resolve (primary platform).

Have a strong eye for visual rhythm, music-driven pacing, and emotional storytelling.

Understand how to shape raw 
nts into a cohesive narrative, not just cut to music.

Are highly organised, reliable with deadlines, and comfortable working independently.

Communicate clearly, receive feedback well, and care deeply about quality.



Experience:

Proven experience editing weddings or similarly emotional, story-based content.

Film-inspired colour grading is a strong advantage, but not essential.



What I offer:

Consistent work (starting at approx. 2 weddings per month, with room to grow).

Clear creative direction, reference films, and style guides.

A collaborative, respectful working relationship - no rush culture, no burnout timelines.

Projects that value story, pacing, and craft.

Competitive freelance rates based on skill and experience.



Practical Requirements (Remote):

Stable, high-speed internet and the ability to handle large file transfers.

Comfortable working with structured feedback and revision cycles.

Availability for some overlap with AEST business hours.



To apply, please send:

A short introduction about you.

Your showreel or recent examples of work - wedding only examples please.

Your timezone and general availability.



If you love storytelling, care about detail, and want to edit work that feels meaningful, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Amazon VA: Graphic Designer (Female)
description:
Position: We are looking for an experienced FEMALE Amazon Virtual Assistant specializing in Graphic design.

Our Business Model: Private Label (Note: we are not Wholesale, Online Arbitrage)

Full-time. 40 hours each week. Please do not apply if you are holding other jobs.

Remote (Work-from-home)



We need an Amazon-focused graphic designer who understands Amazon’s specific image requirements, content formats, customer buying behavior, and Seller Central processes. The ideal candidate can create high-quality Amazon content, conduct competitor research, identify opportunities to improve clicks and conversions, and manage completed assets inside Amazon Seller Central.



This is not a general graphic design role. We are looking for someone with proven Amazon experience, not someone who only knows how to use Photoshop, Illustrator, or AI tools. The right candidate understands how to create Amazon-specific visual content that is attractive, informative, and strategically optimized to support listing performance.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Design and optimize Amazon listing images.

-Create Premium A+ Content for desktop and mobile.

-Design Amazon Brand Story modules and Storefront pages.

-Create product and packaging mockups.

-Design product packaging and box artwork using supplier-provided dielines.

-Conduct market and competitor research using Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools to identify opportunities to improve our listing images, product messaging, layout, and overall presentation.

-Use AI tools to generate specific image elements, backgrounds, settings, or concepts when needed.

-Edit and refine all elements in Adobe Photoshop so the final images look realistic, accurate, and professional.

-Upload and manage listing images, A+ Content, Brand Story, and Storefront content in Amazon Seller Central; monitor approval status, display quality, and mobile responsiveness; and revise designs based on feedback, performance results, and Amazon requirements.

-Maintain organized source files, final files, revisions, and approved versions.



REQUIREMENTS:

-FEMALE applicants only

-Must have proven work experience as an Amazon Graphic Designer or Amazon VA handling creative content for Amazon FBA Private Label products. Please do not apply without relevant Amazon experience.

-Must provide a strong portfolio showing Amazon listing images, Premium A+ Content, Brand Story, Storefront design, packaging design, and product mockups.

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator.

-Must understand Amazon image requirements, content formats, mobile layouts, and Seller Central processes.

-Experience with Amazon A/B testing or Manage Your Experiments is preferred.

-Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon research tools.

-Experience using AI image-generation tools as part of a professional design workflow while maintaining realistic and accurate final results.

-Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, layout, branding, product accuracy, and conversion-focused design.

-Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret competitor findings and performance data.

-Strong communication skills, with proficiency in written and spoken English.

-Detail-oriented and highly organized, with a high level of accuracy.

-Strong time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines.

-Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

-Willing to learn, adapt, and take on additional responsibilities over time.

-Must have a reliable, fully functional computer suitable for professional graphic design work.

-Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 20 Mbps.

-Must be comfortable using a time-tracking tool during working hours.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:

1. Asia working hours

2. Work-from-home setup

3. Bonus: 13th Month

4. Bonus: Year end

5. Long-term opportunity with career growth

6. Supportive and collaborative team



HOW TO APPLY:

If you are interested in this position and believe you have the qualities listed above to be successful, please submit your applications with the following in the correct order:

1. Cover Letter

2. CV with your education and work experience in chronological order. (Pls. send us the public view link)

3. Portfolio: relevant work samples like Amazon images and A+ Content. (Pls. send us the public view link)

Note: Incomplete applications will not receive a response.



Join our team and grow with us!

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Financial Planning Assistant - Australia (Remote)
description:
Australian Financial Planning Experience Required



We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Planning Assistant to join our growing Australian financial planning firm.



To be successful in this role, you must have a minimum of 6 months' experience working within an Australian financial planning practice. Applicants without Australian financial planning experience will not be considered.



This is an exciting opportunity for an organised, adaptable and motivated professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, embraces variety and challenge, and wants to build a long-term career within the Australian financial planning industry.



You will work closely with our financial advisers, supporting client administration, business operations and the continued growth of our firm.



This role would suit someone who enjoys being part of a growing business and is excited by the opportunity to help develop processes and contribute beyond a traditional administration role.



The ideal candidate will have:



• Minimum 6 months' experience working within an Australian financial planning practice (essential). You should have an understanding of Australian financial planning processes and experience supporting financial advisers.



• Experience using Australian financial planning software and CRM systems (essential). You should be confident working across different platforms, maintaining accurate records and learning new systems quickly.



• Excellent communication skills – Strong written and spoken English, a professional telephone manner and the confidence to ask questions, seek clarification and communicate openly with the team.



• Strong administration and organisational skills – Excellent attention to detail, good numerical ability and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.



• The ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment – As a growing business, priorities and workflows continue to evolve. We are looking for someone who is comfortable with variety, can adapt quickly and remains calm and productive when working under pressure.



• A flexible and proactive approach – This role will involve a range of responsibilities depending on business needs. One day may involve assisting with client paperwork, CRM administration and financial planning tasks, while another may involve supporting business projects, operations or marketing activities. We are looking for someone who is willing to contribute wherever needed.



• A positive and growth-focused mindset – Someone who is open to feedback, willing to learn, comfortable asking questions and excited to take on additional responsibilities as their skills develop.



***For the right person, the role and remuneration will grow in line with their capabilities, initiative and performance.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates professionally and is genuinely motivated to contribute to the success of a growing Australian financial planning firm.



Please note: This position is not suitable for general Virtual Assistants or applicants without Australian financial planning experience.



Application Requirements



Please include a brief covering letter outlining your Australian financial planning experience, the firm(s) you have worked for, your main responsibilities, and the financial planning systems, software and tasks you have experience with.



This will help us better understand your experience and suitability for the role.

title: YouTube Video Editor — Long-Form Vlogs
description:
Moody Imagery is an Australian wedding studio, and we're building a YouTube channel of vlog-style, behind-the-scenes videos about our business and our life running it. We're looking for a YouTube editor who understands long-form vlog storytelling — someone who can turn raw BTS footage into engaging, personable, binge-worthy videos that keep viewers watching to the end.



The style we're going for



Think polished, aesthetic, personable lifestyle vlogs. Our references (please watch these before applying — this is the vibe):











Warm, relatable, story-driven editing with clean pacing, tasteful on-screen text and light motion graphics, music that carries the mood, and subtle sound effects. Engaging — but never over the top. We want refined and intentional, not jumpcut-heavy or gimmicky.



What you'll do



Edit long-form vlog videos (roughly 30–45 minutes each) from our raw BTS footage

Shape a clear, engaging story and pacing that holds retention across the whole video

Add on-brand typography using fonts we provide, plus tasteful captions/text where it helps

Layer subtle, well-timed sound effects and music — enhancing, never overwhelming

Colour correct and clean up our footage (shot on the DJI Osmo Pocket 4)

Keep a consistent look and feel across every video as the channel grows



Who you are



Proven experience editing long-form YouTube vlog / lifestyle content (please send examples — ideally links to videos you've edited)

You understand YouTube specifically: hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling for a watching audience

A tasteful eye for typography, graphics, and sound design — you know where the line is between "engaging" and "too much"

Comfortable colour correcting handheld/gimbal footage

DaVinci Resolve preferred (it's what we use), but we're open to your software if your work is strong — Premiere or Final Cut is fine

Reliable with deadlines, clear written English, and fast internet for large file transfer



Rate & volume



Per-video rate, discussed based on experience (these are meaty long-form edits, and we'll price accordingly). Ongoing work for the right editor as we start to publish regularly.



How to apply



Send (1) links to 2–3 long-form vlogs you've edited (not just short reels — we want to see how you sustain a 20+ minute video), (2) which software you edit in, and (3) a line on which of our reference channels' style resonates with you and why. Shortlisted editors will be paid to complete a test edit on a short section of our real BTS footage.

title: Paralegal/Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly organized and versatile remote virtual assistant/paralegal with a background in legal services, including estate planning, real estate, family law, or personal injury. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of experience as a paralegal or attorney and will be proficient in handling a variety of tasks, including drafting documents, answering phone calls, making calls to customers, calendaring,
 management, and performing various administrative duties. We are looking for someone to work 40 hours per week. The work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Mountain Time - that is 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time for most of the year, and 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM from November through March. This position requires proficiency in English, exceptional communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.



Responsibilities:



- Conduct customer and provider outreach through phone calls and
s, ensuring timely follow-ups and resolution of any issues.

- Assist in legal research, document preparation, and other paralegal tasks as needed.

- Draft and proofread correspondence, forms, and legal documents in clear written English.

- Handle general administrative tasks, including data entry, scheduling, and organization of files and documents.

- Use software including HubSpot, Leap, and Office 365.

- Coordinate with the team to ensure smooth operations and effective communication within the organization.



Requirements:



- At least 2 years of proven experience as a paralegal, legal assistant, or attorney, with a solid understanding of legal procedures and documentation.

- Strong legal writing skills, including drafting and proofreading documents with correct grammar, spelling, and formatting.

- Excellent written and spoken English, and a professional phone manner for effective customer and provider interaction.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several matters at once.

- Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote environment.

- Familiarity with case management, CRM, and office software such as HubSpot, Leap, and Office 365.

- A quiet workspace, a reliable computer, and backup internet.

- Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement. You will handle client files.



How to apply: If you are a dynamic, self-motivated professional with the required skill set, we would love to hear from you. Send your application with the subject line "Paralegal EA - [Your Name]" and include all four of the following:



1. Your resume.

2. Confirmation that you can work 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time.

3. In two or three sentences, describe your experience in one of the practice areas listed above.

4. Write the following
 as if you were sending it today. A client has called twice this week asking why her case has not moved. You do not have an answer yet because you are waiting on a document from the other side. Write the
 you would send her. Six sentences or fewer.



Applications missing any of the four items will not be reviewed.



Salary: $5.00 to $8.00 USD per hour, based upon experience and probation period.

title: Experienced Inbound & Outbound Appointment Setter — Verified Results Required
description:
EXPERIENCED INBOUND AND OUTBOUND PHONE SETTER — NOT ENTRY LEVEL



Prosper is hiring a full-time remote appointment setter for U.S. solar and home-services campaigns. This role is for a proven phone setter who can respond quickly to inbound inquiries, re-engage older leads, make high-volume outbound calls, qualify homeowners, handle objections, maintain accurate CRM records, and book appointments that actually show.



PAY AND SCHEDULE — READ BEFORE APPLYING



• $6 USD per hour

• Paid monthly, not weekly or biweekly

• Full-time, 40 hours per week

• Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time)

• No commission, bonus, automatic raise, or guaranteed promotion is promised in this listing



Prosper is growing from a strong financial foundation and building a long-term sales organization. Consistent setters can be considered for greater responsibility as the company grows, based on verified production, reliability, appointment quality, clean CRM work, and business need.



Qualified applicants must be available for a live group interview on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time). Role-specific evaluation follows the group introduction.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Work fresh inbound leads immediately by phone, text,
, and CRM follow-up

• Make consistent outbound calls to warm, aged, cold, and reactivation lead lists

• Build rapport, control the conversation, ask qualification questions, and identify genuine homeowner interest

• Handle objections calmly and move qualified prospects to a clear next step

• Book accurate appointments on the correct calendar

• Confirm appointments, reduce no-shows, and collect required pre-appointment information

• Log every call, outcome, callback, note, and disposition accurately

• Hit production targets while protecting compliance and appointment quality



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



• At least two recent years of phone appointment-setting, inside-sales, or high-volume call-center experience

• Proven experience with BOTH inbound lead response and outbound/cold or reactivation calling

• Measurable recent results: daily call volume, qualified appointments, and show rate

• Experience with a dialer and CRM such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar

• Clear spoken and written English suitable for U.S. homeowners

• Experience qualifying prospects, handling objections, scheduling appointments, confirming attendance, and keeping clean CRM notes

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, professional headset, quiet workspace, and dependable availability



Solar, roofing, HVAC, insurance, real estate, home improvement, telecommunications, or other U.S. home-services experience is strongly preferred.



DO NOT APPLY IF



• Your experience is limited to chat, social media, content, data entry, or general virtual-assistant work

• You have not personally worked both inbound and outbound phone leads

• You cannot provide real production numbers from a recent role

• You need basic phone-sales training before working independently



HOW TO APPLY



Your first line must be exactly:



I understand the rate is $6 USD/hour paid monthly, and I can attend Tuesday, August 11 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time.



Then answer every question:



1. How many years of inbound and outbound appointment-setting experience do you have?

2. In your most recent role, how many inbound leads did you work per day and how many outbound calls did you make?

3. How many qualified appointments did you average per week or month, and what was your show rate?

4. Which dialers and CRMs have you used?

5. Describe one difficult objection you regularly handled and how you moved the conversation forward.

6. Which U.S. industries have you called, and what qualification criteria did you use?



REQUIRED VIDEO AUDITION



Include a resume, redacted proof of prior production, and one continuous 90–120 second video. State your name, years of inbound and outbound experience, and your most recent verified call and appointment numbers. Then role-play this situation:



A U.S. homeowner completed an online form asking about solar. When you call, the homeowner says, “I was just looking, I am busy, and I do not want a sales pitch.” Demonstrate your opening, two or three useful qualification questions, your objection response, and your request for a scheduled appointment with a closer.



Do not read a generic script. We evaluate tone, listening, conversation control, qualification, objection handling, and the clarity of your appointment ask. Do not invent savings, tax-credit eligibility, utility information, or promises not provided in the scenario.



Applications missing measurable phone-setting evidence, complete answers, or the requested video will not advance. Redact all customer names, addresses, phone numbers, account details, and other private information.

Everyone on your list has bought property for cash recently. They want deal flow. Your job is to find out what kind.

title: Experienced U.S. Solar Closer — Verified Closing Results Required
description:
EXPERIENCED U.S. SOLAR CLOSER — PROVE YOUR RESULTS



Prosper is recruiting an experienced remote closer for U.S. homeowner solar and home-energy opportunities. You must be able to take a qualified, held sales conversation through discovery, presentation, objection handling, a clear decision, accurate documentation, and a clean internal handoff.



This is not an entry-level sales, appointment-setting, cold-calling, lead-generation, customer-service, or virtual-assistant position. Applicants must prove that they personally conducted full sales presentations and closed real customers.



COMPENSATION — READ BEFORE APPLYING



• Commission-only opportunity

• No hourly wage or base salary is promised

• Commissions can range from $6,000 to $10,000 USD per sale, depending on the transaction and written compensation plan

• Prosper pays 100% of commissions that are earned under the written agreement

• “100% payout” means 100% of the earned commission—not 100% of the customer contract value or company revenue

• The exact earning event, payment timing, cancellation rules, and any chargeback or clawback terms will be provided in writing before engagement

• The stated range is not guaranteed income

• Prosper does not guarantee appointments, closings, sales volume, or a minimum number of commissions



Prosper is growing from a strong financial foundation and building a serious long-term sales organization. Proven closers can earn greater responsibility as the team, markets, and volume grow. Advancement depends on verified results, ethical sales quality, customer retention, leadership ability, and business need.



Evidence-qualified applicants must be available for a live group interview on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time). A smaller role-specific closer evaluation follows.



WHAT YOU MUST BE ABLE TO OWN



• Review lead and appointment history before each presentation

• Establish trust quickly with U.S. homeowners by phone or video

• Run complete discovery around goals, usage, concerns, timing, and decision process

• Present the approved solution accurately without inventing savings, incentives, timelines, or guarantees

• Explain the process, available payment or financing options, and next steps in plain language

• Handle price, timing, trust, spouse or co-decision-maker, comparison-shopping, and “I need to think about it” objections ethically

• Ask directly for a decision when the opportunity is qualified

• Complete accurate CRM notes, documents, and internal handoffs

• Follow up professionally and protect cancellation quality

• Report held presentations, closes, close rate, cancellations, and retained results honestly



MINIMUM EXPERIENCE



• At least three recent years in full-cycle phone, video, or consultative closing

• Direct experience closing U.S. consumers

• U.S. solar, roofing, HVAC, insurance, real estate, telecommunications, financing, or home-improvement experience is strongly preferred

• A measurable record of held presentations, closed sales, gross close rate, retained close rate, average deal value, and cancellations

• Experience using a CRM and a structured sales process

• Clear spoken and written English suitable for high-trust homeowner decisions

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, professional headset and camera, quiet workspace, and dependable Eastern Time availability



DO NOT APPLY IF



• Your experience ends with setting appointments, cold calling, transferring calls, or reading a script

• You cannot separate booked appointments from held presentations and closed sales

• You cannot provide redacted evidence supporting your recent results

• You use vague claims such as “top performer,” “high ticket,” or “great closer” without numbers

• You need basic discovery, objection-handling, or closing training

• You will not complete the required video and live role-play



HARD APPLICATION GATE



Your first line must be exactly:



My verified close rate was ___ percent across ___ held presentations during ________, and I can attend Tuesday, August 11 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time.



Then answer every question:



1. What product or service did you personally close?

2. Which U.S. markets or states did you serve?

3. During your most recent measured period, how many appointments were assigned, how many were held, and how many did you close?

4. What were your gross and retained close rates?

5. What was the typical contract value or revenue per sale?

6. Were opportunities inbound, setter-booked, self-generated, reactivation, or mixed? Give the breakdown.

7. Did you close by phone, video, or in person?

8. Which CRM, proposal, financing, and e-signature tools did you use?

9. What three objections did you hear most often, and how did you diagnose each one?

10. Describe one sale you deliberately declined because it was not appropriate for the customer.

11. What was your cancellation, rescission, refund, or chargeback rate?

12. Why did your last closing role end, and may Prosper verify your role and results?



REQUIRED PROOF



Attach all of the following:



• Current resume

• Redacted CRM dashboard, scorecard, commission statement, or manager-issued performance report showing held presentations and closed results

• One professional reference who supervised or audited your production

• One continuous 3–5 minute solar closing audition



REQUIRED VIDEO AUDITION — PROVE IT



Do not use slides, editing, background music, or a copied internet script. Look into the camera and treat this as a live U.S. homeowner conversation:



The homeowner owns the home and pays approximately $250 per month for electricity. The homeowner wants to lower long-term energy costs but is skeptical because a friend said solar is a scam. The homeowner does not want a high-pressure presentation and says, “I need to talk to my spouse before I make any decision.” You do not have the utility history, roof design, credit information, final system design, financing terms, or an approved savings proposal.



Show how you would:



1. Open and set a clear agenda

2. Ask useful discovery questions before presenting

3. Explain the potential value of exploring solar without inventing savings, incentives, approval, or system details

4. Diagnose and respond to the trust and spouse objections

5. Ask for an appropriate commitment or next step



We evaluate discovery, listening, credibility, structure, objection diagnosis, ethical persuasion, and the strength of the close. A loud sales pitch without discovery will score poorly. Unsupported claims are an automatic rejection.



Applications with missing questions, vague numbers, no evidence, or no video will not advance. Never submit private customer information or recordings you do not have permission to share. Redact all personal and contract details.

title: Sales Development Representative (outbound calling)
description:
You've achieved great results in sales, appointment setting, or telemarketing. You're resilient, you don't take rejection personally, and you understand that the phone is your primary tool. You're comfortable with cold calling and know that every 'no' gets you closer to a 'yes'. But you're ready for a role where your effort is directly tied to your results.



You'll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your end goal is to fill the CEO's calendar with qualified appointments. You'll be proactively prospecting and calling a mix of warm leads, contacts from our database, and cold lists. Your job is to generate the activity that creates the pipeline. You'll qualify them, handle objections, and book them for a meeting with the CEO.



We have a strong lead database and we need you to take ownership of finding and creating opportunities. This means a significant portion of your time will be spent on cold calling and prospecting. The role will be high-volume and requires discipline and resilience.



The role will be challenging and demanding. You'll be expected to make a high volume of calls, face frequent rejection, and maintain a positive, professional attitude. You need to be able to work independently, manage your time effectively, and take full ownership of your results. This is not a role for someone who needs a warm lead handed to them.



In return, you'll be paid a base hourly rate plus a generous bonus for every qualified appointment that is kept. You'll have the opportunity to receive full training on the Performia methodology and sales process once proven your ability. You'll work from home with a flexible, cheerful, and outcome-focused team. There are significant growth opportunities for top performers.



If you are someone who cannot work independently, needs to be around people all the time, or cannot handle cold calling and rejection, then this role will not be right for you.



If you're driven and love the challenge of the hunt, apply now.



IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS. 



We will only consider candidates who submit their application to our candidate management system.

title: Dental Virtual Assistant
description:
We are established dental clinic in Melbourne, looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant to assist with patient recall, reactivation and treatment follow-up. 



This role is ideal for someone who has previous experience working remotely for an Australian dental practice or healthcare clinic, particularly with patient recalls and appointment booking. 



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

Your primary focus will be helping us reconnect with existing patients and encourage them to return to the clinic.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Contacting patients who are overdue for their 6-monthly dental check up and clean 

- Reactivating patients who have not attended the clinic for an extended period 

- Following up patients with outstanding or incomplete treatment plans 

- Calling, SMSing and/or
ing patients to help organise appointments

- Following up patients who may not respond to the first contact 

- Booking appointments directly into our appointment book where appropriate 

- Keeping accurate notes of conversations and follow-up attempts 

- Maintaining an organised follow up list so patients do not fall through the cracks 

- Providing regular updates on contacts made, appointments booked and follow-ups required



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

We are specifically looking for someone who:

- Has previous experience with dental patient recalls, reactivation or treatment follow up 

- Is confident speaking with patients over the phone 

- Has excellent spoken and written English 

- Has a warm, friendly and natural communication style 

- Understands how to encourage a patient to book without sounding overly sales-focused or pushy

- Is comfortable handling common patient objections such as being busy, cost concerns, wanting to think about treatment, or simply forgetting to book

- Is proactive and comfortable following up patients more than once when appropriate

- Is organised and reliable

- Can work independently and take ownership of the recall/reactivation list 

- Understands the importance of patient privacy and confidentiality 



Dental experience is highly preferred. Please let us know which dental practices, dental software or patient management systems you have previously worked with. 



PHONE CALLS 

We use a VoIP phone system, so ideally you will be comfortable accessing and making calls through our VoIP system remotely. 



Patients should feel as though they are speaking directly with a friendly member of our dental team.

title: Social Media Content & Community Specialist (Remote)
description:
Job Type



Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Position



Monthly Salary



PHP 40,000 to PHP 50,000 per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Performance-based bonuses may be available based on content output, engagement, lead generation, and overall results.



Work Schedule



Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week.



You must be available for at least four hours of overlap with Eastern Time in the United States.



Exact working hours can be discussed based on availability.



About the Company



Max Credit is a United States-based financial services company that helps entrepreneurs improve their credit, become funding-ready, and secure business funding.



We are looking for a creative, organized, and reliable Social Media Content & Community Specialist to help us consistently publish high-quality content, grow our online presence, engage with our audience, and generate qualified leads.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We need someone who understands content creation, personal brand social media growth, video editing, audience engagement, and how content can support sales.



Primary Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts

* Turning long videos, Zoom recordings, podcasts, voice notes, and raw footage into multiple pieces of content

* Adding captions, graphics, music, sound effects, transitions, and other engaging elements to videos

* Creating carousel posts, promotional graphics, story graphics, and educational content

* Writing strong hooks, captions, headlines, and calls to action

* Scheduling and publishing content across multiple social media platforms

* Maintaining and organizing the company’s content calendar

* Researching industry trends, popular content formats, relevant topics, and trending audio

* Engaging with followers by responding to comments and basic direct messages

* Identifying qualified leads and escalating them to the appropriate tea
mber

* Organizing raw content, completed content, brand assets, and project files

* Monitoring content performance and preparing a weekly analytics report

* Recommending ways to improve reach, engagement, lead generation, and content quality

* Following up with the owner and team when content, approvals, or information is needed

* Using artificial intelligence tools to improve productivity without producing low-quality or generic content



Required Skills



The ideal candidate must have:



* Strong written and spoken English

* Proven short-form video editing experience

* Experience creating content for Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, or YouTube

* Strong knowledge of Canva and CapCut

* A good understanding of hooks, storytelling, captions, calls to action, and audience retention

* Experience scheduling and publishing social media content

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organizational and time-management skills

* The ability to manage multiple deadlines without constant supervision

* The ability to communicate proactively and ask questions when instructions are unclear

* Reliable internet access and a dependable computer

* The ability to receive feedback and make revisions quickly

* A portfolio showing previous video editing, graphic design, or social media work



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Financial services

* Credit repair

* Business funding

* Business coaching

* Personal branding

* Digital marketing agencies

* Sales funnels

* Lead generation

* GoHighLevel

* 

* Asana

* Notion

* ChatGPT or other artificial intelligence tools



What Success Looks Like



The person selected for this role will help us:



* Publish content consistently across all major platforms

* Turn raw recordings into polished, engaging content

* Increase engagement and qualified conversations

* Build a more organized and reliable content production system

* Respond to comments and messages promptly

* Improve content performance over time using analytics

* Reduce the amount of day-to-day content management required from the owner



You will be evaluated based on consistency, communication, quality of work, ability to meet deadlines, content output, engagement, and qualified leads generated through social media.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership of their work

* Does not need to be reminded repeatedly about deadlines

* Communicates when there is a problem instead of disappearing

* Pays close attention to instructions

* Can work independently

* Is creative but also organized

* Can follow an established brand style

* Is comfortable suggesting new ideas

* Wants a stable, long-term position

* Is interested in growing with the company



How to Apply



To be considered, please include all of the following in your application:



1. Start your application with the word BLUEPRINT.

2. Introduce yourself and explain why you believe you are a strong fit for this position.

3. Provide a link to your portfolio.

4. Provide examples of short-form videos, graphics, or social media accounts you have worked on.

5. Explain your specific responsibilities for each account or project you share.

6. Tell us which editing and social media tools you use.

7. Provide your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

8. Confirm your availability and the hours you can work.

9. Share your internet speed and computer specifications.

10. Describe your process for turning one long video into multiple pieces of short-form content.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short paid test project before receiving a final offer.

title: Google Merchant Center Specialist - Shopify E-commerce
description:
# Google Merchant Center Specialist - Shopify E-commerce



We are a rapidly expanding e-commerce business with multiple active Shopify stores across different markets, and we're continuing to grow.



To support our expansion, we're looking for an experienced **Google Merchant Center Specialist** who has a strong understanding of Google Merchant Center policies, Google Shopping requirements, Shopify compliance, and store approval processes.



The ideal candidate should be able to review our stores, identify compliance issues, resolve Merchant Center problems, and help us get new stores approved and ready for Google Shopping.



## What You'll Be Doing:



* Reviewing Shopify stores before submitting them to Google Merchant Center

* Ensuring stores comply with Google Merchant Center and Google Shopping policies

* Helping get new Merchant Center accounts and stores approved

* Identifying and fixing policy violations and account issues

* Handling Google Merchant Center diagnostics, warnings, disapprovals, and suspensions

* Reviewing stores for potential **Misrepresentation** issues

* Checking website compliance, including:



  * Contact information

  * Shipping policies

  * Return and refund policies

  * Payment information

  * Business information

  * Product information

  * Checkout experience

* Reviewing and optimizing product feeds

* Fixing product disapprovals and feed errors

* Checking product titles, descriptions, images, prices, availability, and other feed attributes

* Configuring and troubleshooting Shopify product feeds

* Working with feed management apps such as Simprosys or similar tools

* Checking Merchant Center shipping and return settings

* Assisting with business verification and Merchant Center setup

* Troubleshooting Google Shopping and Google Merchant Center issues

* Preparing and submitting account reviews or appeals when appropriate

* Staying up to date with Google Merchant Center policies and changes

* Helping with other Google, Shopify, and e-commerce related tasks when needed

* Documenting problems and solutions clearly for the rest of the team



## What We're Looking For:



* Previous hands-on experience with **Google Merchant Center**

* Strong knowledge of Google Merchant Center policies and Google Shopping requirements

* Experience getting Shopify stores approved for Google Merchant Center

* Experience dealing with Merchant Center suspensions and policy violations

* Strong understanding of Google's **Misrepresentation** policy

* Experience diagnosing and fixing product disapprovals

* Good understanding of Shopify

* Experience with product feeds and feed management tools

* Experience with Simprosys is a strong advantage

* Understanding of shipping, returns, refunds, checkout, and website compliance requirements

* Ability to identify problems before submitting a store for review

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong written English communication skills

* Ability to research and understand Google policy updates

* Ability to work independently and follow internal procedures

* Reliable, organized, and solution-oriented

* Willingness to learn and adapt as the business continues to grow

* Availability to work 6 days per week



## What You'll Get:



* Competitive hourly pay based on experience

* Performance-based bonuses

* Consistent work across multiple Shopify stores

* A supportive and growing e-commerce team

* Opportunity to take responsibility for Google Merchant Center operations across multiple markets

* Opportunities to grow into a larger Google Ads / E-commerce Operations role



## Ready to Join Our Team?



### How to Apply:



Send us:



* Your resume

* A short motivational letter

* Details about your previous Google Merchant Center experience

* Examples of Merchant Center issues or suspensions you have successfully resolved

* How many stores or Merchant Center accounts you have worked with

* Which Shopify feed apps or tools you have experience using



Please mention **"Merchant"** in your application so we know you read the entire job post.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA / Online Arbitrage Product Researcher
description:
Amazon Product Sourcing VA — Online Arbitrage / Storefront Stalking



Starting Pay: $5.00/hour

Hours: 40 hours/week

Work Type: Remote | Full-Time



?



About the Role



We operate a growing Amazon resale business and are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help source profitable products every day.



Your primary responsibility will be to use a sourcing strategy called Storefront Stalking. You’ll analyze Amazon seller storefronts, identify profitable products, locate suppliers online, and submit qualified buying opportunities for review.



This is a structured, analytical role. Success comes from following a proven process precisely and consistently—not from guessing or improvising. If you enjoy working within established systems and continuously improving, you’ll thrive here.



Every lead you submit will be reviewed. You’ll receive clear feedback explaining what was done correctly, what needs improvement, and why.



?



How the Position Works



3-Day Paid Trial



Your first 3 days are a paid trial.



As long as you follow the SOP and submit quality leads, you’ll be paid for every hour worked—no exceptions.



During the trial, you’ll:



* Follow our SOP

* Submit real product leads

* Receive feedback on your work



If your work meets our standards, you’ll move directly into the full-time position.



We don’t conduct lengthy interviews—your work speaks for itself.



?



Full-Time Position



Once hired, you’ll work approximately 40 hours per week sourcing profitable products.



You’ll continue receiving feedback on your submissions and will be expected to apply that feedback consistently.



VAs who take feedback seriously and improve over time are the ones who grow the fastest—and the ones we invest in the most.



Repeatedly making the same mistakes after they’ve been explained is the primary reason someone is removed from the role.



?



Growth Opportunities



Top performers may receive:



* Performance bonuses

* Pay increases

* Promotion into VA management

* Long-term opportunities, such as Sales Manager



If you consistently perform well and continue improving, there is a clear path for growth.



?

We’ve built this role to make success as straightforward as possible.



You’ll receive:



* A detailed step-by-step SOP

* A dedicated AI assistant trained on our workflows, sourcing criteria, and common questions

* Direct access to your manager whenever needed

* Continuous feedback to help you improve



?



Responsibilities



You will:



* Browse Amazon seller storefronts

* Analyze products using SellerAmp SAS

* Research suppliers through Google Shopping and retailer websites

* Apply coupons and discounts where available

* Simulate checkout to verify final costs

* Submit complete, accurate leads into Google Sheets

* Review feedback and continually improve



?



Product Requirements



Products generally must meet our sourcing criteria, including minimum requirements for:



* Sales Rank

* Monthly Sales

* ROI

* Profit

* Competition

* Buy Box stability

* Amazon presence

* IP safety

* Private label risk



All specific buying criteria will be covered during training.



?

* Product title

* ASIN

* Amazon listing

* Supplier link

* Final buy cost

* Selling price used

* Estimated profit

* ROI

* Fulfillment method

* Monthly sales

* Sales Rank

* Offer count

* Promo codes used

* VA notes



Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.



?



Requirements



Required



* Previous experience with Amazon Online Arbitrage

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Proficiency with Google Sheets

* Reliable internet connection and personal computer

* Good written English

* Ability to follow detailed processes independently



Preferred



* Experience with SellerAmp SAS and/or Keepa

* Experience calculating ROI and profit margins



?



Who This Role Is For



You’ll do well in this role if you’re:



* Patient

* Detail-oriented

* Methodical

* Coachable

* Comfortable following structured, analytical systems



This role is not a good fit if you regularly cut corners, guess, or ignore instructions.



If you enjoy learning, improving, and following proven systems, we’d love to hear from you.



?



Before You Apply



Please read this entire posting carefully.



Only apply if, when accepted, you’re ready to begin your 3-day paid trial within 24 hours.

 address.

?

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

title: International Marketing Officer
description:
Position Overview:



The International Marketing Officer is responsible for supporting the organisation’s international student recruitment and marketing activities, with a primary focus on Australia Onshore and other designated international markets. The role involves developing and implementing marketing initiatives, maintaining strong relationships with education agents, analysing market trends, and providing administrative support throughout the student enrolment and admissions process.







Key Responsibilities:



Marketing and Campaign Management

* Plan, develop, implement, and monitor international marketing campaigns across digital and traditional marketing channels.

* Coordinate promotional activities, events, webinars, exhibitions, and recruitment initiatives to increase international student enrolments.

* Monitor campaign performance and prepare reports with recommendations for continuous improvement.

* Develop marketing materials and promotional content suitable for international markets.



Education Agent Relationship Management

* Establish, develop, and maintain strong professional relationships with international education agents and business partners.

* Provide timely information, training, and marketing support to education agents.

* Regularly communicate with agents regarding course offerings, admission requirements, promotional campaigns, and recruitment opportunities.

* Monitor agent performance and assist in identifying new partnership opportunities.



Market Research and Business Development

* Analyse international education market trends, competitor activities, and student demand.

* Conduct market research to identify emerging recruitment opportunities.

* Prepare reports, recommendations, and strategic proposals to support business growth and international market expansion.

* Contribute to the development of annual marketing and recruitment strategies.



Student Enrolment and Admissions Support

* Assist prospective international students throughout the enquiry, application, and enrolment process.

* Liaise with education agents and applicants to ensure complete and accurate application documentation.

* Coordinate with internal admissions staff to facilitate timely processing of student applications.

* Provide excellent customer service to prospective students and education agents.



Administrative Duties

* Maintain accurate records of marketing activities, agent communications, and recruitment outcomes.

* Prepare regular reports on marketing performance, recruitment statistics, and market intelligence.

* Assist with other marketing, recruitment, and administrative duties as required.







Essential Skills and Experience:



* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, International Business, Education, or a related discipline.

* Minimum two years’ experience in international marketing, student recruitment, education consultancy, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of the international education sector and student recruitment processes.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.

* Excellent organisational and time management abilities.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with an international team.



?



Desirable:



* Experience working with Australian education providers, Registered Training Organisations (RTOs), colleges, or universities.

* Existing network of international education agents, particularly within the Philippines.

* Experience using digital marketing platforms, social media advertising,
 marketing, and CRM systems.

* Knowledge of Australian student visa processes and international student admissions.







Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):



* Achievement of international student enrolment targets.

* Successful planning and execution of marketing campaigns.

* Growth and engagement of international education agent partnerships.

* Quality and timeliness of market research and strategic recommendations.

* Student enquiry conversion and application processing efficiency.

* Overall satisfaction of education agents and prospective students.

title: Full-Time Remote Video Editor
description:
WE’RE HIRING: FULL-TIME HIGH-LEVEL VIDEO EDITOR



We are hiring a  HIGH-LEVEL Video Editor to turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, high-retention short-form content.**



This is a FULL-TIME position and requires your FULL COMMITMENT.



You must NOT currently be working a full-time job or actively editing for other companies or clients. We are looking for someone who can make this role their primary professional commitment and be fully available to our team.



If you’re looking for a side gig, freelance project, or something to fit around other clients, **this is not the position for you.**



## THIS IS NOT BASIC EDITING.



You must understand:



* Jump cuts & micro-cutting

* Pattern interrupts,  zooms, motion, pacing, B-roll, etc.

* Captions that actually get read

* Fast-paced storytelling

* Strong hooks and retention

* How to keep something changing every 1–3 seconds

* How to turn raw footage into content people actually want to watch



If your edits feel **slow, basic, outdated, or low-energy**, this will not be a fit.



# WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Turn event and raw footage into Reels, Shorts, and other short-form content

* Edit fast, tight, high-retention videos

* Produce quality content consistently and at scale

* Follow our editing standards and creative direction

* Work closely with our team and meet deadlines

* Eventually help us bring on additional editors

* Review and supervise other editors’ output as you grow into the role



## IMPORTANT: FULL-TIME COMMITMENT



This role is for someone looking for a **long-term, full-time position — not freelance work.**



To be considered:



* You should **not currently have another full-time job**

* You should **not be actively committed to other companies or editing clients**

* You must be ready to make this position your **primary work commitment**

* You must have the availability and focus to consistently deliver for our team

* We expect reliability, communication, ownership, and long-term commitment



We want someone who wants to **grow with the company**, take on more responsibility, and eventually help lead our video editing team.



# PAY



**Starts at $800/month**



This is just the starting point.



The right person will have the opportunity to:



* Increase their compensation quickly based on performance

* Take on greater responsibility

* Help recruit and train additional editors

* Supervise and maintain the quality of their output

* Grow into a leadership role within the editing team



**The better you perform and the more responsibility you can handle, the more you can earn.**



## TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY



**1. Put the word WARRIOR in your FIRST sentence.**



If WARRIOR  is not in your first sentence, we will assume you did not read the post.



**2. Send 2–3 examples of your BEST short-form video edits.**



Do not send us everything you’ve ever edited. Send your strongest work.



**3. Confirm in your application that you are available FULL-TIME and are not currently committed to another full-time job, company, or ongoing editing clients.**



**4. Be prepared to complete a test assignment.**



Qualified applicants will receive a test assignment immediately.



Your portfolio and first sentence need to make us stop.



**Make them count.**
