We are a fast-growing ecommerce apparel brand producing high-volume paid social content. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Creative Operations Coordinator to manage the operational side of our influencer and UGC content pipeline.



You will keep creator projects moving, organize submitted content, conduct creative research, and ensure deadlines are met.



This will allow our Creative Strategist to focus on creative direction, ad concepts, and performance.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

UGC and Influencer Coordination

• Write influencer and UGC briefs using our templates and brand guidelines

• Manage the complete creator-sourcing process through Billo, Insense, or similar platforms

• Upload briefs, review and hire creators, create orders, and track deadlines

• Review submitted content to ensure it follows the approved brief

• Follow up with creators regarding delayed, missing, or incomplete deliverables

• Organize clips, raw footage, and b-roll into clearly labeled folders

• Maintain an accurate tracker for active and completed creator projects



Creative Research and Support

• Research winning ads within our niche using Meta Ad Library and competitor accounts

• Compile relevant ad examples, hooks, angles, and content formats for review

• Maintain an organized library of competitor and inspiration ads

• Tag and categorize creative references so the team can easily find them

• Support the Creative Strategist with research and creative coordination tasks



Reporting and Pipeline Management

• Prepare a short weekly digest covering relevant marketing holidays, creator deadlines, platform deadlines, and priority concerns

• Monitor the content pipeline and proactively identify possible delays or bottlenecks

• Communicate clearly and promptly when additional information or decisions are needed

• Ensure project trackers, folders, and creator records remain accurate and updated



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in ecommerce, preferably supporting a creative or marketing team

• Hands-on experience using Billo, Insense, or a similar UGC platform

• Excellent written English and strong attention to detail

• Highly organized, proactive, responsive, and dependable

• Able to manage multiple creator projects and deadlines simultaneously

• Comfortable using Claude or other AI tools as part of a daily workflow

• Confident asking questions when instructions or expectations are unclear

• Able to work independently in a remote environment



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience writing UGC briefs, ad copy, scripts, or product descriptions

• Experience reviewing creative performance or working with media buyers

• Familiarity with Meta Ad Library research

• Experience managing content libraries, trackers, or project-management systems



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your written application with the exact phrase: “I am creative.”



Send your complete application to 
 and include the following:



* A short and updated resume highlighting your relevant experience in ecommerce, UGC coordination, creative research, copywriting, and AI tools.



* A brief explanation of why you would be a strong fit for this position.



* A description of one UGC or influencer content process you managed from beginning to end. Include the platform used, your responsibilities, how you managed the workflow, and the outcome.



* A two-minute introduction video. Begin your video by saying, “I am creative.”



* While recording your video, share your screen and show examples that demonstrate the relevant skills mentioned in this job post. These may include UGC coordination, creator tracking, creative briefs, content organization, competitor ad research, or similar work.



* Your face must remain clearly visible throughout the entire video, including while sharing your screen.



* Accessible links to your resume, introduction video, and work samples. Check the sharing permissions before sending your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions or do not include a specific end-to-end UGC or influencer process example will not be considered.

title: AI Creative Specialist Needed - $900+/month + Performance Bonuses (Long-Term Position)
description:
WHO WE ARE



RoofIgnite runs Meta advertising systems for roofing and HVAC contractors doing serious volume. Every ad we run needs a creative behind it, and that creative has to look real. Not stock-photo real, not obviously-AI real. Real enough that a homeowner scrolling their feed believes it's their neighbor's roof getting done.



We run hundreds to thousands of ads at a time across clients. That means we need a constant supply of new creative that doesn't look recycled, doesn't look fake, and doesn't get flagged by the platform or ignored by the scroll.



That's where you come in.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Bad creative doesn't just underperform, it costs our clients money and it costs us the account. Good creative is the difference between a $40 cost-per-lead and a $15 cost-per-lead. You're not making pretty pictures. You're making the thing that d
 whether a homeowner stops scrolling or keeps going.



We're handing you real reference material and real client accounts. What you produce goes straight into live ad campaigns spending real client budget. If it looks fake, we feel it immediately in the numbers, and so does the client.



This is a long-term seat. We're not looking for someone to test the waters for a few weeks. We want someone who gets better at this every month for the next year and beyond, and who wants to grow with the company as our creative demand scales.



This is an urgent hire. We want someone starting immediately.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



CORE (this is the heart of the job):



AI Image Generation

Take existing reference images and turn them into new, branded ad creatives. That means:

- Swapping faces

- Replacing logos and company branding

- Adding realistic people (sales reps, technicians, homeowners)

- Adding realistic local environments (houses, streets, trash bins, vehicles, etc.)

No distorted faces, no extra fingers, no obvious AI tells. If it looks fake, it doesn't ship.



Video Creation & Editing

Create short AI-generated videos when a campaign calls for it, and edit both AI and non-AI footage into a polished final cut that's ready for paid placement.



Creative Iteration

Follow feedback fast and precisely. You'll get notes on what's not converting or what looks off, and you'll turn those into the next version same day, not next week. Speed matters here as much as quality.



SECONDARY (steady, but not the main event):



Photo Editing

Basic cleanup and polish work in Photoshop or Canva, touching up AI output so it holds up under close inspection.



Organization

Keep creative assets, versions, and client folders organized so nothing gets mixed up across accounts. When you're producing at volume, a messy system costs everyone time.



THE PART MOST PEOPLE GET WRONG:



This role needs two things that rarely live in the same person: real AI tool fluency AND a sharp eye for what actually looks fake. Most applicants have one. The tool-fluent people generate fast but don't catch the extra finger or the warped doorframe. The detail-oriented people catch every flaw but can't produce fast enough to keep up with hundreds of ads running at once. We need both in one person. If you're missing either, this isn't your role, and that's okay.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real, hands-on experience with AI image generation tools (NanoBanana, Higgsfield AI, ChatGPT, Sora, Kling, or similar). Not "I've played around with it."

- Ability to make AI output look realistic under scrutiny, no distorted faces, hands, or artifacts

- Fast turnaround on feedback and revisions

- Basic photo editing skills (Photoshop or Canva a plus)

- Fluent English, written and spoken

- Able to work full-time, Eastern Time Zone hours, 40 hrs/week



BONUS



Experience running Meta ads. If you understand the ad account side, you'll know why certain creative gets approved and certain creative gets suppressed, and you'll build for that from the start.



PAY AND BONUSES



Starting salary is $900 USD/month. On top of that, you earn performance incentives tied to how your creatives actually perform in the ad accounts. Creative that drives bookings at a lower or equal cost than what's already running gets rewarded. Do the work well and you make more. We run hundreds to thousands of ads at a time, so there's real room to grow your output and your pay here.



THE SCREENING TEST (REQUIRED)



Before you apply, generate 2 to 3 sample images that include all three of the following in one image: a person, branding, and a real environment.



Completing this is required, not optional.



To apply, start your application with the word CREATIVE so we know you read this whole post.



Any application that skips the sample images, skips the CREATIVE keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a hard gate.



HOW TO APPLY



A recording is mandatory. Submit either a Loom video (strongly preferred) or a Vocaroo voice recording (
).



In your recording, cover:

1. Your name and location.

2. What AI tools you use and how you make your images look realistic for ads.

3. What sets you apart from other candidates when we consider bringing you on the team.



Applicants who submit sample images correctly and include a recording are the only ones we'll consider for an interview. No recording, no interview.



The recording is also how we screen English fluency and personality for a role where you'll get fast, direct feedback constantly, so speak clearly and naturally. Be yourself.



Roof Ignite Ltd. is a marketing agency.

description:
Job Title:

AI Video Editor for Social Media Reels (Vertical Short-Form)



Type of Employment: Part Time



Wage/Salary: $4 – $6 USD/hour (based on experience)



Desired hours per week: 20



About Us:

We are a U.S.-based premium creative agency producing hyperrealistic AI-generated video content for business owners. We create short-form vertical reels using AI avatars and modern editing.



What You'll Do:

Handle the FULL production process of vertical 9:16 short-form videos (15–40 seconds) for social media (Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn). This includes writing AI prompts, generating images and video with AI avatars, generating voice, and editing the final video in CapCut — all following our brand style guide. You deliver finished, ready-to-publish videos, uploaded to a shared Google Drive.



Key Skill — AI Character Creation (very important):

A core part of this role is creating and maintaining hyperrealistic, consistent AI avatars/characters across multiple videos. You must be able to:

Generate realistic human avatars that look like real people (NOT obviously AI-generated, no plastic or fake look)

Keep the same character consistent across different videos (same face, same identity)

Place the character in realistic, believable settings (offices, cafés, real-life scenarios)

Use reference/master images and detailed prompts to maintain consistency

If you can make AI avatars look genuinely real and consistent, you are exactly who we're looking for.



Content Formats You Should Know:

You should have experience creating and editing these types of short-form content formats:

UGC style (with product and without product)

Podcast format

Voice-over format

Dualcast format (two-person / split conversation style)

Viral trends format

Static image ads

The more formats you can produce well, the better.



Tools & Accounts:

You must have your OWN active accounts and subscriptions for the tools below. We provide a monthly tool bonus to help cover your subscription costs. You'll use your accounts to produce our content, following our brand kit and reference materials (master character images, prompts, and style guide that we provide).



Required Tools (you must have your own):

CapCut (video editing) — REQUIRED

Google Flow / Omni Flash (AI video) — REQUIRED

Nano Banana Pro (AI image) — REQUIRED

ElevenLabs (AI voice)

ChatGPT / Claude (AI assistants)

OpenAI GPT Image / GPT Image 2

Ability to write effective AI image and video prompts — REQUIRED



What We're Looking For:

Strong eye for clean, minimal, premium design (not flashy or cluttered)

Experience editing short-form vertical reels specifically

Consistent and able to meet weekly delivery deadlines

Reliable, fast, detail-oriented

Able to follow a brand style guide precisely (colors, fonts, format)

Good communication, responsive during work hours



Language:

For team meetings, communication, calls, or instructions, we normally speak English or use a translator — that works perfectly fine.

IMPORTANT: The video content we share to work on is mostly in SPANISH (very few in English). All scripts, titles, dialogue, subtitles, and audio you'll work with are written in Spanish, for a Latino market.

You should be able to read and understand written Spanish well enough to edit, time subtitles, and sync voice correctly — always with the manager's support. Even if you don't speak it fluently, that's not a problem if you can use a translator on your computer.

If you understand Spanish OR you're comfortable using a translator, this role can work great for you.



Nice to Have:

Portfolio of vertical short-form reels

Understanding of social media pacing and hooks



How to Apply:

Write "REEL-PRO" at the top of your application so we know you read the full post

Send your portfolio or samples of vertical short-form videos you've edited

Tell us which of the tools above you've used and for how long

Tell us about your experience creating realistic, consistent AI avatars (with examples if possible)



We'll start with a small paid test project before ongoing work.

title: SEO Copywriter
description:
# SEO Copywriter (Contract-to-Hire) — Digital Marketing Agency



Type - Contract-to-hire (start as contractor, potential to move into a permanent role)

Hours: ~20 hours/week during contract phase

Pay: $8-10/hour, based on experience

Location:Remote

Experience: 2–4 years in SEO copywriting



## About Us



Makarios Marketing is a digital marketing and SEO agency serving 25–30 active clients across a wide range of industries — ecommerce, home services, medical, legal, real estate, and more. We move fast, we care about quality, and we build long-term client relationships by delivering content that actually ranks and converts.



## The Role



We're looking for a copywriter who understands that SEO copy is more than stuffing keywords into paragraphs. You'll be writing content that needs to rank in search AND persuade a real human to take action — service pages, location pages, local SEO mainly, ecommerce collection pages, blog posts, landing pages, and ad copy.



This starts as a 20 hr/week contract role. If you're reliable, fast, and your work consistently hits the mark, this becomes a permanent position with more hours and responsibility.



## What You'll Be Writing



- SEO service pages and city/location landing pages for local businesses

- Ecommerce collection and category page copy

- Blog posts targeting specific keywords and search intent

- Content for high-authority third-party placements (parasite SEO) — you should understand how writing for someone else's domain differs from writing for a client's own site

- Ad copy and conversion-focused landing pages (Google Ads, paid social)

- On-page SEO elements: meta titles, meta descriptions, header structures



## Must-Have Skills (please don't apply without these)



- Proven copywriting ability — you can write persuasive, natural-sounding copy that sells, not just "content." Portfolio required.

- Working SEO knowledge — search intent, keyword placement, header hierarchy, E-E-A-T, and how to write for both rankings and readers

- Internal linking strategy — you understand anchor text best practices, site architecture, and how to weave internal links into copy naturally (not bolted on as an afterthought)

- Familiarity with parasite SEO — you know what it is, why it's used, and how to write content for high-authority third-party platforms

- Ad and landing page copywriting — you can shift from informational SEO content to direct-response copy when the project calls for it



## Nice-to-Have (bonus points)



- Experience writing for multiple industries/niches

- Familiarity with tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Surfer, or Google Search Console

- Understanding of local SEO and Google Business Profile content

- Experience with CMS platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Magento, Squarespace)

- Basic understanding of CRO principles



## What Working With Us Looks Like



- You'll create clear briefs with target keywords, internal linking targets, and reference pages 

- You will write content for other sites to help pages rank

- Direct feedback and fast turnaround expectations

- Consistent, ongoing work across a stable client roster (this isn't a one-off gig)

- A team that communicates via Slack and respects your time



## How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **"Anchor"** so we know you read this posting.

2. Include 2–3 writing samples that show range — ideally at least one SEO page (service, location, or collection page) and one piece of direct-response copy (ad, landing page, or sales page).

3. Briefly describe your experience with internal linking and parasite SEO in 2–3 sentences each. No fluff — just show us you actually understand these.

4. Include your hourly rate you want

5. Also what local seo work you've done thats our main IC



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Systems Integrator
description:
Systems Integrator

100% Remote | Full-Time

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time

Compensation: $1,500–$2,000 per month (based on experience)



About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Systems Integrator to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with leadership to document processes, improve workflows, and build organized systems that support daily operations and future growth.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys process improvement, workflow design, documentation, and creating efficient operating systems.



Responsibilities:

- Document internal processes and create clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Build and improve workflows for client onboarding and service delivery.

- Configure and maintain ClickUp workspaces, including templates, automations, dashboards, custom fields, and task dependencies.

- Develop systems that improve team collaboration and operational efficiency.

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview

title: Item Setup & Catalog Specialist
description:
Company Overview

We are a Los Angeles-based wholesale fine jewelry company established in 1972, supplying gold and silver jewelry to major national retailers, warehouse clubs, military exchanges, and leading e-commerce marketplaces. The company is building a lean, systems-driven operations team where accurate product data is treated as a competitive advantage.

 

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Item Setup & Catalog Specialist to own the complete lifecycle of product master data and retailer item onboarding.

This role is responsible for creating accurate product records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, coordinating cross-functional teams to gather product assets, managing retailer portal uploads, maintaining retailer requirements documentation, and ensuring product data remains accurate throughout its lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, process-driven, and capable of managing multiple product launches while maintaining exceptional data accuracy.

 

Key Responsibilities

Product Master Data Management

• Create and maintain new product records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

• Ensure every item contains complete and accurate information before retailer submission, including:

o Vendor cost

o Cost of goods

o Metal type and fineness

o Product weight

o Dimensions

o UPC/GTIN

o Product hierarchy

• Maintain the ERP as the company's single source of truth.

Retailer Requirements Management

• Build and maintain a centralized retailer requirements matrix documenting:

o Image specifications

o Product description requirements

o Required attributes

o Pricing fields

o Compliance requirements

• Keep documentation current as retailer standards evolve.

Product Launch Coordination

• Coordinate with Sales, Merchandising, Warehouse, and Photography teams to collect all required launch assets.

• Identify missing information and proactively follow up until every requirement is completed.

• Track all outstanding launch requests through completion.

Retailer Portal Management

• Upload products into retailer and marketplace portals.

• Verify listings after publication.

• Resolve listing errors within 48 hours of discovery.

Product Data Governance

• Manage updates to:

o Product costs

o Pricing

o Metal cost adjustments

o Product discontinuations

• Maintain proper change logs and ensure Business Central remains accurate.

Competitive & Retailer Research

• Perform scheduled retailer and competitor assortment scrapes using company templates.

• Deliver structured pricing and assortment reports to Sales and Merchandising teams.

Documentation & SOP Development

• Create and maintain SOPs for:

o Item creation

o Retailer upload processes

o Product data management

o Retailer scraping procedures

• Continuously improve documentation for scalability and operational consistency.

 

Escalation Process

Tier 1

• Resolve missing information and routine retailer portal issues independently.

Tier 2

• Escalate ERP or Business Central technical issues to ERP support.

Tier 3

• Escalate any issue impacting committed retailer launch dates directly to the President.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Less than 1% post-launch item setup error rate.

• 100% completion of Business Central item records before retailer uploads.

• Retailer requirements matrix reviewed and updated monthly.

• Product launches completed within retailer SLA once assets are received.

• 100% on-time delivery of scheduled retailer and competitor scrapes.

• Listing errors corrected within 48 hours.

 

Required Qualifications

• Minimum 2 years of experience in:

o Item setup

o Catalog management

o Product data operations

o Retail or e-commerce environments

• Experience onboarding products through retailer or marketplace portals such as:

o Walmart

o Sam's Club

o Amazon

o DSCO

o Similar enterprise retail platforms

• Experience working with ERP systems and item master data.

• Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience is highly preferred.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills with experience handling structured datasets.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Strong organizational and follow-up abilities.

• Available to work with meaningful overlap during US Pacific business hours.

 

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience within jewelry, precious metals, or luxury products.

• Knowledge of:

o Gold karats

o Metal fineness

o Stone specifications

• Experience creating SOPs and operational documentation.

• Understanding of retailer image specifications, including resolution, aspect ratio, and background standards.

 

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will:

• Be exceptionally detail-oriented and process-driven.

• Take full ownership of product data quality.

• Be proactive in coordinating multiple stakeholders.

• Thrive in a fast-paced operational environment.

• Have strong ERP and catalog management experience.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
Remote | Flexible Work | Luxury Medispa



Help Build One of the UK's Most Trusted Medispa Brands

This isn't a typical social media role.

We're not looking for someone to simply post on Instagram.

We're looking for someone who understands luxury branding, content strategy, consumer psychology and how to build trust through exceptional content.

Someone who understands that social media isn't about chasing trends or going viral.

It's about educating.

Building authority.

Creating trust.

Growing a community.

And ultimately helping more people choose Perfection.

If you're someone who believes every piece of content should have a purpose, we'd love to hear from you.



About Perfection

Perfection is a multi award-winning luxury Medispa nestled in the beautiful Cotswolds UK.



Since 2011 we've helped thousands of clients look and feel amazing through advanced laser hair removal, skin treatments, aesthetics and wellness.



We're proud to be recognised as one of the region's leading clinics.

Our clinic owner, Michelle, is a Professional Beauty Judge, industry educator and published co-author.

We've been featured in BBC, Vogue and Tatler.

We're home to:

• Gold Standard Lumenis Laser Technology

• A nationally recognised Level 7 Aesthetics Nurse

• Medical-grade skincare including ZO Skin Health, IMAGE Skincare, AnteAGE and Hypo21

• Over 550 five-star Google reviews

• More than 15 years of trusted experience

• One of the most established laser clinics in the area, offering permanent hair removal solutions for all hair colours

Our reputation has been built on expertise, honesty and exceptionally high standards.

Now we're looking for someone to help tell that story.



The Role

Your job isn't to create content.

Your job is to build one of the most recognisable luxury Medispa brands in the UK.

Every post should educate.

Every story should strengthen our relationship with our audience.

Every reel should reinforce why Perfection is different.

Every caption should build trust.

We're looking for someone who understands that the business which answers its customers' questions best earns their trust.

We don't want content for the sake of content.

We want content with purpose.



What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Planning & Organisation

We believe great content is planned, not rushed.

We work well in advance.

For example, whilst publishing July's content, we'd already expect August's content to in the process of being planned, created and approved.

You'll be responsible for:

• Monthly content planning/Content Calendar

• Scheduling content in advance

• Identifying upcoming post opportunities

• Ensuring content is ready well ahead of publication



2. Content Strategy

This role is as much about thinking as it is creating.

You'll identify what our ideal clients genuinely want to know and turn those questions into engaging content.

Rather than generic posts like "5 Benefits of HIFU", we'd much rather create content such as:

• Why are celebrities and leading skin specialists moving towards collagen stimulation treatments?

• Why doesn't every laser achieve the same results?

• Why are consultations so important?

• Why do results vary between clinics?

• Why is experience so important in laser hair removal?

• Why does medical-grade skincare make such a difference?

• What makes someone unsuitable for treatment?

• Why are our standards different?

Every client question is an opportunity to educate and build trust.



3. Content Creation

Create elegant, premium content including:

• Reels

• Educational carousels

• Photography

• Graphics

• Before and afters

• Client journeys

• Testimonials

• Team features

• Behind-the-scenes content

• Product education

• Campaign launches

We already have an extensive library of footage and photography and are continually filming new content, so you'll have plenty of high-quality assets to work with whilst also identifying opportunities for future filming.

Quality will always come before quantity.



4. Build Authority

Don't tell people we're experts. Show them.

Your content should continually reinforce our expertise through:

• Michelle's industry credentials

• Professional Beauty judging

• Published co-author status

• Awards

• BBC, Vogue and Tatler features

• Therapist qualifications

• Ongoing training

• Gold Standard technology

• Medical-grade skincare

• Clinical standards

• Treatment protocols

• Client journeys

• Before and after results

• Testimonials and reviews

• Behind-the-scenes preparation

• The luxury client experience



5. Community Management

We're looking to build a genuine community.

You'll:

• Respond to comments

• Reply to direct messages

• Encourage conversations

• Increase engagement

• Build relationships with our audience

We want to achieve a good response rate, with messages and comments responded to promptly within UK working time. One of our biggest goals is increasing meaningful engagement with our existing followers.



6. Analytics & Reporting

Produce a monthly performance report including:

• Reach

• Engagement

• Shares

• Saves

• Website clicks

• Consultation enquiries

• Best-performing content

• Audience insights

• Recommendations for the following month

We don't want vanity metrics.

We want actionable insights that help improve performance.



Brand Consistency Is Non-Negotiable

One of the biggest responsibilities of this role is protecting our brand.

People should recognise a Perfection post before they ever see our logo or username.

Every post should look and feel unmistakably Perfection.

Luxury brands aren't built by constantly reinventing themselves.

They're built through consistency.

You'll be expected to follow our brand guidelines meticulously, including:

• Typography

• Font choice

• Font sizes

• Colours

• Layouts

• White space

• Photography style

• Editing style

• Tone of voice

• Messaging

• Design hierarchy

This isn't an arts and crafts project.

Every piece of content should feel like it belongs to the same premium brand.



Publishing Expectations

We're not interested in flooding social media.

We'd rather publish fewer, exceptional pieces of content than lots of average ones.

Typically we'd expect:

• 4 Posts a week cross-posted across Instagram and
 (including weekends) with a buffer of 5 posts for occasions or feature events.

• Daily Stories

• Consistent community engagement

• Educational content throughout the month

The schedule should always be led by quality rather than volume.



Approval Process

All content, captions, campaigns and creative concepts must be submitted to Izzy for approval before sending back to Izzy for publication.

You'll work collaboratively, welcome feedback and continually refine content to ensure it reflects the Perfection brand.



The Person We're Looking For

You'll probably love this role if you:

• Have experience working with premium or luxury brands

• Understand aesthetics, skincare or the beauty industry

• Understand consumer psychology

• Think strategically rather than tactically

• Have an excellent eye for detail

• Understand branding

• Love educating through content

• Can write exceptional copy

• Understand content strategy

• Enjoy analysing performance

• Take genuine pride in your work

• Care about quality more than quantity



You Notice The Things Others Miss

You notice inconsistent fonts.

You notice when spacing is slightly off.

You notice poor alignment.

You notice weak copy.

You notice when something doesn't feel premium.

You understand that luxury is built through consistency and attention to detail.



We'd Love You To Bring...

• Fresh ideas

• Commercial thinking

• Initiative

• Curiosity

• A willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• Recommendations backed by data

• A genuine desire to build something exceptional

We're not looking for someone to simply complete a task list.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a guardian of our brand.



How We Work

This is a remote position with semi-flexible working hours.

We don't micromanage.

We hire talented people, trust them to do great work and give them ownership.

In return, we expect initiative, accountability and exceptionally high standards.



Technology & AI

We embrace technology and use AI every day to help us work smarter.

We're always open to new tools that improve efficiency, generate ideas, support research and streamline workflows.

However, AI should enhance creativity, not replace it.

We're looking for someone who understands where AI adds value and where genuine human insight, experience and judgement are irreplaceable.

Content should never feel generic, templated or obviously AI-generated.

Every piece of content should reflect the Perfection brand, our expertise and our personality.

AI can help us work faster.

It should never dilute the quality of our brand.



How We'll Measure Success

Success isn't measured by follower numbers.

Or how many posts go live.

Success looks like:

• A social media presence that is instantly recognisable as Perfection.

• Increased engagement from our existing audience.

• More meaningful conversations.

• More shares and saves.

• More consultation enquiries.

• Consistent daily Stories.

• Stronger brand recognition.

• A growing library of educational evergreen content.

• Followers choosing Perfection because they already trust us before they even enquire.



Sound Like You?

If you're excited by the idea of building a recognisable luxury brand, creating content that genuinely helps people, and becoming part of a business with exceptionally high standards, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send us:

• Your CV

• A short cover letter telling us why this role interests you

• Examples of social media accounts you've managed

• Examples of content you're most proud of

• Any relevant analytics or results you've achieved

title: Shopify Specialist for Compliance-Ready Store Builds
description:
Summary

Ethereal Solutions is a Dutch e-commerce agency working with 70+ brands across the Netherlands, Germany, France, Spain, the UK and the US. We build and optimize Shopify stores for founders and dropshippers, and we specialize in getting stores approved and scaled inside Google Merchant Center and Google Shopping.



Our builds are not generic template jobs. Every store we deliver has to survive a Google policy review, look premium enough to convert cold traffic, and stay consistent across multiple markets. That standard is the whole job.



What you will do



You will own the build and optimization of client stores from brief to handover.



Build complete Shopify stores from a brief: home, collection, product, cart, policy, contact and about pages



Upload and structure catalogs: variants, pricing, metafields, clean product descriptions, SEO titles and meta descriptions

Prepare product imagery: background removal, consistent cropping, uniform product sets, lifestyle and banner placement



Write and place custom HTML and CSS blocks inside Shopify sections when the theme cannot do it natively



Guard business detail consistency across the entire store: legal name, address, registration number, VAT, phone and
 must be identical on every policy page, the contact page, the footer and checkout, with zero variation



Set up multi-market stores: markets, currencies, translated content, market-specific policy variants



Run speed and mobile QA before every handover





What we are looking for



1+ years of hands-on Shopify experience, not WordPress or Wix with some Shopify on the side



A real design eye. Our house style is minimalist and Scandinavian: generous whitespace, restrained typography, no clutter, no stock-template feel



Obsessive attention to detail. A single mismatched phone number between a policy page and a footer can cost a client their Google account. That is the level we work at



Strong written English is a significant plus



Reliable async communication: daily progress updates, no disappearing.



Able to work independently from a written brief and a Loom recording without needing to be managed hour by hour



Nice to have



Experience with Google Merchant Center, product feeds, or feed tools like Simprosys



Familiarity with EU consumer law requirements on policy pages (herroepingsrecht, Widerrufsbelehrung, Impressum)



Experience with AI image generation tools for product and lifestyle imagery



Klaviyo, Figma, or basic conversion rate optimization background



How we work



Briefs come to you structured, with references and assets. You get direct access to whoever owns the project, not a chain of account managers. We move fast, we give clear feedback, and we expect the same directness back.



What we offer



Consistent, ongoing volume. This is not a one-off project, it is a long-term seat

Clear briefs and fast payment

Room to grow into a lead builder role as our build volume increases



Direct exposure to how a real agency handles Google compliance, media buying and scaling, which is knowledge you will not get from a course



We start with one paid test build so both sides can see how the collaboration works before committing to a long-term contract.



How to apply



Generic proposals will be ignored. To be considered, include the following:



Start your proposal with the word Nordic so we know you read this



Links to three Shopify stores you personally built or rebuilt, with a short line on each explaining exactly what you did

We read every proposal that follows these points. We reply within 48 hours either way.

title: Experienced Land Comping VA — Real Estate Research + SMS (11AM–3PM EST)
description:
We are a U.S. land investment company that buys and resells vacant land parcels. We are hiring an experienced Virtual Assistant to run property comping and support our SMS seller pipeline.



Prior land or real estate comping experience is required. This is not an entry-level or training role. You must already understand what a comparable sale is and why a bad comp kills a deal.



What you will do:

• Comp vacant land parcels using our ChatGPT comping plugin — we will give you access and our exact prompt process

• Verify plugin output against the subject parcel: acreage, access type, zoning, subdivision, sold date

• Flag comps that do not match on size band, access type, or subdivision context

• Calculate and record price per acre; enter all findings into our comp sheet in a consistent format

• Flag missing data instead of estimating it — we need gaps identified, not filled in

• Manage inbound seller replies in Smarter Contact: tag leads, respond using our approved scripts, route qualified sellers to the owner

• Keep lead status and notes current so no seller goes unanswered



Requirements:

• Prior experience comping real estate or land — you must be able to describe your past process

• Available Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM New York time (EST/EDT). Fixed schedule, not flexible. For Philippines-based applicants this is roughly 12:00 AM – 4:00 AM local time — confirm you can work this consistently.

• Strong written English — you will be messaging U.S. property sellers directly

• Comfortable with Google Sheets, ChatGPT, and web-based research

• Reliable internet and backup power/connection



Nice to have:

• Experience with Smarter Contact, Podio, GoHighLevel, or similar CRM

• Experience with land wholesaling specifically



This role is NOT for you if:

• You have never comped a property before

• You estimate numbers instead of verifying them

• You are managing several other clients at the same time



How to apply:

Start your application with the word PARCEL so we know you read this fully.

Then answer:



Describe your comping experience. What property types, what markets, what tools?

title: Remote CRM & Customer Support Specialist – Guest Operations (Panama, Long-Term)
description:
Remote CRM & Customer Support Specialist – Guest Operations (Panama, Long-Term)



Full-time · Freelance / Independent Contractor · US$700–850/month to start



This is a remote digital-operations role, not a hotel front desk.



Villa Alejandro has operated boutique hotels in Boquete, Panama for ten years. We currently run six properties with close to 70 accommodation units and are expanding to ten and beyond. Our guest operation is fully remote and almost entirely text-based: guests reach us through messaging,
 and the major booking platforms.



Because we are growing, we are building the team out — and the people who perform here move up. Supervisory and management positions in our remote operation are filled from within.



What the job actually demands: speed on a keyboard and speed in a CRM. You will run several customer conversations across several channels at the same time, work with several applications open in parallel, and close every loop with clean documentation.



Hospitality, short-term-rental or OTA experience is welcome — but it is not required and it is not what we select on. The strongest people in this role come from CRM, ticketing, dispatch or high-volume chat support. If you have lived inside Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, a ticket queue or a dispatch board under real volume, you are the profile we are looking for — whether that was in BPO, SaaS, e-commerce, travel support or an in-house system.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Answer guest inquiries by messaging,
 and booking platforms

* Support reservations, check payment and booking status, coordinate online check-in and room access

* Give concierge and local-information support

* Work across our booking and property systems and keep guest and reservation records current

* Coordinate with housekeeping and local operations

* Document what is done, what is pending and what needs follow-up, and hand over cleanly to the next shift

* Report system or communication problems immediately



REQUIREMENTS



* Fluent written and spoken English, approximately C1 level — no certificate required

* 50+ WPM typing, 60+ preferred — take the 1-minute test at 
 before applying

* Real experience in a CRM, helpdesk, ticketing, dispatch or high-volume chat-support system

* A computer that keeps at least 20 browser tabs open at once, plus a video call, without slowing down (min. 8 GB RAM, 16 preferred, SSD). Why: this role runs many applications and platforms in parallel. Closing and reopening them costs time on every single request — the systems stay open all shift.

* Power backup and a backup internet connection: a power bank or UPS, plus a mobile SIM or hotspot. Why: outages happen — in the Philippines as in Panama. A guest waiting at 11 PM cannot be told the power went out. Being able to keep working through an outage is part of this job, and how you prepare for it tells us how you work.

* Primary internet 20+ Mbps

* A computer used only by you — shared devices are not accepted for confidentiality reasons

* Private, quiet workspace; camera and screen sharing

* Both rotating shifts, including weekends and holidays

* Time Doctor while clocked in (nothing outside paid time); no other paid work during our shifts



NICE TO HAVE (not required): hotel, short-term-rental or OTA background · hotel PMS experience · Spanish



AUTHORITY: Refunds, discounts, free late checkouts, payment or room-access exceptions always require supervisor approval.



SCHEDULE: 5 shifts per week, 40 paid hours.

AM 8:00 AM–4:30 PM Panama (9:00 PM–5:30 AM PH)

PM 3:00 PM–11:30 PM Panama (4:00 AM–12:30 PM PH)

8 paid hours + 30 min unpaid break. Optional 6th shift paid proportionally.



COMPENSATION AND DEVELOPMENT



* US$700–850/month to start, depending on experience and verified skills

* Paid via Western Union, transfer fee covered by us

* Performance and pay review after 3 months; strong performers move up significantly

* Intensive onboarding and training in the first weeks — fully paid

* Growth path into supervisory and management roles as we expand



WHAT HAPPENS AT THE INTERVIEW — read this before you apply



Everything you write below is verified live on a shared screen:



* You repeat the typing test live. The result must match what you wrote.

* You show your computer's system information, open 20+ tabs while we watch, and run a live speed test on your main connection and your backup.

* You show your power backup and the workspace you will actually use.

* You answer detailed questions about the systems you listed, and complete a live multitasking exercise.



There is no advantage in overstating anything. A significant gap between the application and the live check ends the process on the spot.



HOW TO APPLY



 
 with the subject:



RGOS Application – [Your Full Name]



On OnlineJobs.ph, put that same line as the first line of your message.



We evaluate only the answers written directly in the message body. Attachments, screenshots and external links do not replace the requested answers. A generic cover letter is not needed — answer all six sections, concisely and specifically.



1. TYPING TEST

Complete the 1-minute test at 
.

* WPM:

* Accuracy:

One exact result, not a range.



2. REMOTE AND SYSTEMS EXPERIENCE

* Years of remote work:

* Most recent remote position:



For each important CRM, helpdesk, ticketing, dispatch, booking or support system:

* System name:

* Company or position where you used it:

* Length of experience:

* What you personally did inside the system (not just the software name):



Also:

* In a normal shift, roughly how many chats, tickets,
s or open cases did you handle?

* Highest number of conversations or cases you handled at the same time:



3. WORK SETUP

* Computer model:

* Processor:

* RAM:

* Operating system:

* Primary internet provider and speed:

* Backup internet provider and connection type:

* Power-backup solution:

* Computer used only by you: Yes/No



4. AVAILABILITY

* Available for both rotating shifts: Yes/No

* Available on weekends and holidays: Yes/No

* Previous night-shift experience — where, and for how long?

* Time Doctor accepted: Yes/No

* Other current job, client or business:

* Other paid work during Villa Alejandro shifts: Yes/No



5. WORK ORGANIZATION AND JUDGMENT

Answer both, briefly.



A. Queue management

You have eight open customer conversations. Two are waiting for information from another department, one customer has followed up twice, and a new urgent case arrives.

How do you organize the work, prioritize the cases, and make sure nothing is forgotten?



B. Operational scenario

At 11:00 PM, three situations happen at the same time:

* A guest reports the air-conditioning is broken and demands a full refund or another room. The property is full and maintenance is available at 8:00 AM.

* Another guest requests a free late checkout until 3:00 PM.

* An arriving guest requests the room-access code, but payment and online check-in have not been verified.



Describe your first five minutes:

* In what order do you handle the three situations?

* What do you say to each person?

* What do you verify and document?

* Which decisions require supervisor approval?

* What stays pending and needs follow-up?



6. HONESTY

Which requirement, if any, do you not currently meet completely?



You may use AI to improve the English in your application, but all facts, experience and answers must be your own and truthful.



Individual applicants only. No agencies, recruiters or service offers.

nt in their lives.



What You’ll Do:

Requirements & Qualifications:

- Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly, whether over the phone,
, or text.

- Strong multitasker - able to move quickly while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

- Energized by our mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it.

Bonus Points

Details:

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

title: Accountant - Australian Business compliace
description:
Role – Business Compliance

Experience – 1+ year(s) of prior Australian experience Location: Remote / Onsite (Philippines)

Job Description:

Finalization of Accounts and Financial Statements:

1. Finalize books of accounts and prepare accurate Financial Statements for various entities.

2. Perform reconciliation and verification activities to ensure the integrity of the Balance Sheet, including:

• Full reconciliation of all bank accounts, ensuring closing balances match with bank statements.

• Review and reconcile accounts receivable and payable; investigate and clear abnormal or outstanding balances.

• Reconcile the Fixed Asset Register/Schedule with the General Ledger, ensuring additions, disposals, and depreciation are updated accurately.

• Reconcile GST and ATO liabilities, ensuring closing balances align with lodged returns and ATO records.

• Perform inter-entity loan reconciliations and ensure reciprocal entries are consistent across entities.

• Reconcile Hire Purchase (HP) liabilities with applicable HP schedules.

3. Conduct General Ledger analysis to ensure:

• Completeness and accuracy of income and expense accounts.

• Correct allocation of transactions and appropriate GST treatment.

• Identification and rectification of discrepancies to maintain financial accuracy.

4. Prepare reconciliation schedules and collate supporting working papers to substantiate all closing balances in the financial statements.

Preparation of Tax Returns for Entities

1. Prepare tax returns for Companies, Trusts, and Partnerships based on finalized financial statements.

2. Ensure accurate presentation of income and expenses under ATO-designated labels.

3. Review tax return items for compliance with ATO rules on assessable income and allowable deductions.

4. Prepare and maintain supporting schedules including franking credits, rental property schedules, capital gains schedules, and other required disclosures.

Preparation of Tax Returns for Individuals

1. Scrutinize the client-provided source documents to determine the nature and taxability of income.

2. Verify proper classification of all income and deductions in compliance with ATO requirements.

3. Complete individual tax returns, updating relevant schedules such as:

• Rental property

• Foreign income

• Sole trader/business income

• Capital gains

4. Maintain and update working papers to support disclosures made in the tax return.

Collaborate with internal teams and respond to queries promptly Attend periodic workflow and review meetings

Software Proficiency Required: Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks

title: Ecommerce Operations Assistant
description:
To be considered, please complete our official application: 
 — this is the only way to move forward.



Ecommerce Operations Assistant

Full-Time · Remote



About AUGO

Take life to go.

That’s what AUGO is about. For the mom whose back door is always open with kids and dogs running through. For the off-roader strapping his ATV onto the truck. For families, adventurers, and everyone in between — AUGO is built to come with you.

We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling durable, practical products across home and outdoor categories — including our magnetic screen doors and retractable ratchet straps. We’ve built a strong Amazon business with thousands of 5-star reviews, and we’re now scaling onto TikTok Shop, Shopify, and international marketplaces.

To keep growing at pace, we need someone who can execute across the entire operation.



The Role

We’re hiring a full-time Ecommerce Operations Assistant to be the tactical backbone of our team.

This is a shared role — you’ll support multiple department heads across Amazon operations, customer service, multi-platform store management, pricing, and light sourcing. You won’t be siloed to one area. You’ll be the reason customer messages get answered fast, listings stay healthy, pricing stays consistent across platforms, and the operation runs smoothly across countries.

You’ll report to the team through a shared task queue. Priorities are set collaboratively each week. Your job is to execute — cleanly, quickly, and with the kind of attention to detail that makes department heads want to keep giving you more.

If you love variety, ownership, and being trusted across an entire operation, this role is for you.



What You’ll Own

Amazon Listing Monitoring & Support Monitor Amazon listing health across our catalog. Flag issues as they happen — Buy Box loss, suppressed listings, content violations, low inventory alerts. Support listing updates when needed (titles, bullets, descriptions, images). Back up the team on keyword research and backend search terms.

Customer Service Across Channels Respond to Amazon customer messages within 24 hours. Handle the customer
 inbox at 
 Amazon Q&A responses. Escalate complex issues to the right department head. Track recurring issues so we can fix them upstream.

Multi-Platform Store Management Support our Shopify store — product info, imagery, promotions, and updates. Support TikTok Shop backend maintenance. Coordinate updates across platforms so everything stays consistent.

Pricing Across Platforms & Countries Keep pricing accurate and aligned across Amazon (US + international marketplaces), Shopify, TikTok Shop, and any other channels we launch on. Maintain pricing sheets in Google Sheets. Roll out coordinated pricing changes when the team makes them.

Image Work & Content Support Basic image editing in Canva or Photoshop. Prepare listing images to spec across platforms. Support A+ content and promotional graphics when needed.

Sourcing Research Basic supplier research on Alibaba and 1688. Build vendor comparison spreadsheets. Coordinate sample tracking. You’re not negotiating deals — you’re building the data department heads need to negotiate.

Data & Reporting Support Data entry into internal systems. Compile weekly reports across platforms. Ad-hoc analysis for department heads as needed.



What Success Looks Like

•             Monitor Amazon listing health across the catalog — flag issues within 24 hours

•             Resolve customer messages within 24 hours across Amazon +
 inbox (95%+ hit rate)

•             Handle 50+ customer service touches per week solo across all channels

•             Keep pricing accurate and aligned across all platforms + country marketplaces

•             Complete Shopify store updates on schedule

•             Zero escalations on standard operational work after month 1

•             Complete first end-to-end sourcing research assignment by month 2

•             Positive feedback from at least 2 department heads by month 3

•             100% attendance and reliability during first 90 days



30 / 60 / 90 Day Plan

First 30 Days — Foundations & Onboarding

•             Learn AUGO’s products, brand voice, and platform footprint (Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, international marketplaces)

•             Master our tools: Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Shopify admin, Canva, Google Drive, customer
 inbox, VA Task Queue

•             Meet each department head via 15-min intro Loom

•             Assist on 2 real listing monitoring / update tasks (paired review before publish)

•             Handle 10 customer messages/day with review across Amazon +

Days 31–60 — Own Cross-Department Work

•             Take ownership of Amazon listing monitoring solo

•             Handle 30–50 customer messages/week solo across Amazon +

•             Take ownership of pricing consistency across platforms

•             Complete first Shopify store update project

•             Complete first image editing assignment

•             Complete first sourcing research task

•             Begin weekly async check-ins with department heads

Days 61–90 — Optimize & Scale

•             Full ownership of customer inbox at scale (50+/week)

•             Full ownership of Amazon listing health monitoring

•             Own pricing coordination across all platforms

•             Deliver Shopify updates on schedule

•             Complete cross-department sourcing projects

•             Flag process improvements and help refine SOPs



Required Experience

•             1+ year direct hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience — non-negotiable

•             Experience monitoring or managing e-commerce listings

•             Prior customer service background

•             Comfortable managing tasks from multiple stakeholders



Required Skills

•             Near-native written English (9+/10 self-rating)

•             Amazon Seller Central proficiency

•             Customer service written communication

•             Google Workspace proficiency (Sheets, Docs, Drive)

•             Basic Canva or Photoshop

•             Detail-oriented, organized, comfortable multi-tasking

•             Reliable time zone overlap with US Eastern (3–4 hrs/day minimum)



Nice to Have (Not Required)

•             Shopify backend familiarity

•             TikTok Shop backend familiarity

•             Amazon PPC / advertising familiarity

•             Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, or similar tools

•             Alibaba / 1688 sourcing experience

•             International marketplace experience (Amazon EU, UK, CA, AU)

•             Basic spreadsheet formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH)

•             A+ content design experience



Who You Are

•             Self-directed within clear priorities

•             Comfortable receiving tasks from multiple department heads — you don’t get overwhelmed by multi-tasking, you find rhythm in it

•             Strong prioritization judgment — you know what to do first

•             Proactive communicator who flags blockers early

•             Handles pressure well

•             Owns your work — doesn’t wait for permission

•             Team-oriented — you’re comfortable being a shared resource, not a solo hire



Benefits & Culture — Why You’ll Thrive at AUGO

Cross-Functional Exposure Most VA roles pigeonhole you into one narrow area. This one gives you access to every part of the operation — Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, customer service, pricing, sourcing, cross-country work. You’ll learn how an entire e-commerce brand actually runs from the inside.

Direct Line to the Team You’ll work directly with the founder and multiple department heads. No corporate red tape, no committee approvals, no waiting weeks for direction. Real feedback, real answers, real ownership.

A Brand With Proven Traction Thousands of 5-star reviews on Amazon. We’re not a startup guessing at product-market fit — we’re a proven brand scaling across new channels, new countries, and new categories. Your work compounds on real 
ntum.

Real Impact Across Departments Your work moves the needle in customer satisfaction, listing health, pricing accuracy, cross-platform consistency, sourcing costs — everywhere. You’ll see your contribution in real business results, every week.

Growth Path Prove yourself here and there’s room to grow — into specialist tracks (Amazon operations, customer experience, sourcing, international expansion), team lead roles, or department support as AUGO scales.

Fully Remote Work from wherever you’re most productive. All you need is reliable internet, US Eastern time zone overlap, and the discipline to show up every day.

Mission-Driven AUGO is about helping families and adventurers take life to go. You’ll be growing a brand that genuinely makes people’s lives easier — that shows up in every 5-star review, every returning customer, every review that says “buying another one for my in-laws.”

title: High-end video editor and content storyteller (cinematic, social-first)
description:
We’re a creative and marketing agency based in Australia. We shoot and produce high-end brand films, property and commercial content, and social media for a mix of premium brands, builders and developers, and purpose-driven organisations.

We’re after a video editor who can take raw footage and turn it into something that actually holds attention. Not just a cutter, someone who understands pacing, story arc, sound design and how to make a 30 second piece feel like it belongs on a cinema screen, then also knows how to chop that same story into scroll-stopping social cuts.

What you’ll be doing:

 • Editing long-form brand films and property/commercial video from raw footage through to final grade and sound

 • Cutting social-first versions (reels, shorts, TikTok style) from the same shoots, built for retention and platform-native pacing

 • Colour grading to a consistent, premium look across projects

 • Sound design and music selection that supports story, not just fills silence

 • Working from creative briefs and shot lists we provide, with room to bring your own eye to pacing and structure

 • Managing footage and deliverables through our project system and cloud storage

What we need from you:

 • A portfolio that shows real storytelling ability, not just clean cuts. We want to see pacing choices, not just technical polish

 • Strong grasp of both cinematic long-form and short-form social editing, these are different disciplines and we need both

 • Comfortable with Premiere Pro (or equivalent) and a proper colour workflow

 • Understanding of what makes content perform on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, not just what looks nice

 • Reliable communication and turnaround, we work to client deadlines

 • Based in the Philippines, able to work hours that overlap reasonably with AEST (Sydney time)

This starts part-time, with room to grow as our video volume increases. If you’re someone who watches a film and thinks about why a cut worked, this is for you.

To apply: send your reel plus a short video (2 minutes, just talk to camera, phone is fine) telling us who you are, what got you into editing, and what kind of stories you actually want to be telling. Upload it anywhere (Google Drive, YouTube unlisted, Loom) and paste the link in your application. We want to know the person behind the timeline, not just read a list of software you know.

We are a U.S. land investment company that buys and resells vacant land parcels. We are hiring a Lead Manager to own our Smarter Contact pipeline and keep our comping VAs supplied with clean, prioritized work.



This is a coordination and quality-control role. You are the person who makes sure no lead is lost and no VA is idle or duplicating work.



What you will do:

• Own the Smarter Contact inbox: read inbound seller replies, tag them correctly (Hot, Warm, Not Interested, Wrong Number, DNC, Follow-Up), and keep the pipeline current daily

• Clean the database: remove duplicates, merge records, correct bad numbers, suppress opt-outs, and archive dead leads so the list stays accurate

• Assign comping tasks to our comping VAs — decide which parcels get comped first based on seller motivation and response quality

• Track assignments so nothing is comped twice and nothing sits unassigned

• Review returned comp sheets for completeness before they reach the owner — check that required fields are filled and missing data is flagged, not guessed

• Send back incomplete work to the VA with specific corrections

• Maintain a daily pipeline summary for the owner: new leads, hot leads, comps assigned, comps completed, comps pending

• Escalate motivated sellers to the owner immediately rather than letting them sit in queue



Requirements:

• Prior experience managing a real estate lead pipeline or CRM — you must be able to describe how you kept a list clean

• Available Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM New York time (EST/EDT). Fixed schedule, not flexible. For Philippines-based applicants this is roughly 12:00 AM – 4:00 AM local time — confirm you can work this consistently.

• Strong written English — you will be reading seller replies and writing instructions to other VAs

• Organized and systematic. You track things in writing, not in your head.

• Comfortable giving direct feedback to other VAs when work comes back incomplete

• Reliable internet and backup connection



Nice to have:

• Direct Smarter Contact experience (Podio, GoHighLevel, REI Reply, or Launch Control also relevant)

• Experience with land or vacant lot acquisitions specifically

• Basic understanding of what makes a comp usable — you do not need to comp, but you need to spot an incomplete sheet

title: SEO Expert Remote contractor; part-time initially, with the potential to expand following a successful trial
description:
Removalist Now is an Australian online marketplace that helps customers compare quotes from verified removalists for local and interstate moves. We are looking for a careful, resourceful Backlink Outreach & Digital PR Assistant to help grow our online visibility through legitimate, relevant outreach and relationship building.



This is not a role for bulk directory submissions, automated spam outreach, private blog networks, or cheap “guaranteed DA/DR” links. The successful candidate will research relevant websites, identify genuine editorial and partnership opportunities, prepare personalised outreach, maintain an accurate link-building tracker, and monitor live placements. Every paid placement, reciprocal-link proposal, external submission, and final outreach message must be approved before action.



Prospect research

Use Semrush, Google, and manual review to identify relevant websites, journalists, industry partners, property and home-improvement publications, storage providers, relocation resources, and moving-related content opportunities.



Quality qualification

Check each prospect manually for topical relevance, real readership, current content, genuine business/editorial purpose, estimated traffic, outbound-link patterns, country relevance, and a legitimate contact route.



Outreach preparation

Write concise, personalised outreach drafts proposing useful resource additions, expert comments, partnerships, testimonials, or original content ideas. Tailor each draft to the recipient and their audience.



Campaign operations

Maintain a clean Google Sheet or CRM with prospect URL, contact, relevance rationale, target page, outreach status, response, price where applicable, approval status, live link URL, and next follow-up date.



Link monitoring

Check approved live links for correct destination URL, natural surrounding context, anchor text, page indexability, and appropriate sponsored/nofollow disclosure where relevant. Report any changes or broken links.



Competitor analysis

Review competitors’ referring domains and content assets in Semrush to identify replicable, ethical opportunities. Do not copy competitors’ spammy or irrelevant links.



Weekly reporting

Deliver a short weekly report with vetted prospects, drafts ready for approval, outreach sent only with approval, replies, links won, links declined, and any risk flags.



Priority opportunity types

The assistant will focus first on opportunities that are realistic and relevant to an Australian moving and quote-comparison marketplace.





1.Existing business relationships

Removalist partners, storage providers, moving-service suppliers, testimonials, partner-resource pages



2. Resource-page inclusions

Moving-house checklists, property-transition resources, renter guides, relocation pages, moving-cost resources



3. Expert contribution opportunities

Journalist requests, moving-cost commentary, consumer advice, home-moving checklists



4. Relevant editorial outreach

Australian property, home-and-garden, lifestyle, storage, relocation, and small-business relocation publications



5. Carefully screened paid placements

Only after explicit approval, when the host site has relevant real readership and the placement is transparently sponsored or nofollowed



Quality standards and non-negotiable exclusions



A prospect is not qualified merely because it has a high DA, DR, TF, or similar metric. The assistant must favour genuine topical fit and useful audience reach over a metric alone.



Find Australian and Australia-relevant English-language sites, plus carefully selected international moving/property/storage sites.



Submit to generic, duplicate, or low-quality directories without written approval.



Use original, helpful pitches tailored to the publication and audience.



Use scraped
 lists, automated bulk
ing, mass templates, comment spam, forum spam, or web 2.0 links.



Flag sites with casino, crypto, adult, CBD, payday-loan, coupon, SEO-service, or unrelated outbound-link patterns.



Buy, request, or recommend PBN links, link farms, expired-domain networks, undisclosed followed paid links, or “guaranteed rankings.”



Escalate every paid placement, link exchange, guest-post offer, or negative reply for approval.





Required experience and skills



The ideal candidate has experience in manual link prospecting, digital PR, content outreach, or SEO outreach. You should be comfortable reading English-language websites critically, writing concise professional
s, and working carefully in spreadsheets.



Applicants should demonstrate the following capabilities:



English writing

Clear, natural, concise Australian/International English with accurate grammar and no generic sales language.

Manual research

Can identify the difference between an active legitimate publication and a site built mainly to sell links.

SEO understanding

Understands the difference between brand, naked-URL, descriptive, and exact-match anchors; knows why over-optimised anchors can be risky.

Semrush or similar tools

Can use Backlink Gap, Backlink Analytics, Keyword Gap, and Organic Research to build a prospect list; equivalent tool experience is acceptable.

Spreadsheet discipline

Maintains a tracker accurately, avoids duplicate prospects, records sources, and follows naming/status rules.

Integrity and judgement

Experience with Australian property, home improvement, moving, storage, consumer, or small-business audiences is helpful but not essential.
