title: Marketing Assistant | LinkedIn Outreach & Lead Generation
description:
DeepSky is committed to results-oriented individuals ready to contribute to our mission of providing financial literacy to entrepreneurs in the US. We are hiring an Outreach & Marketing Coordinator to run our speaking-driven marketing engine day to day.



You will work directly with our Marketing Lead. Your core job is outreach: getting our founder in front of entrepreneur communities and business organizations where he speaks to rooms of business owners. You find the right groups and hosts, reach out with researched, personalized messages, and coordinate every booked talk from first contact to follow-up. You will also produce and publish LinkedIn content, but you won't be asked to invent it from scratch: we define the audience and provide source content from our founder's talks, and a structured coaching program teaches you the exact system and prompts. Your job is to run that system consistently: materials in, content out, published on schedule, then outreach.



Your core responsibilities:



Outreach: researching entrepreneur communities, business organizations, and event hosts where our founder should speak, identifying the right person to contact, and reaching out with a personalized message worth replying to. We do not do mass messaging or spray-and-pray campaigns, ever. The communities we target are allergic to being pitched, so precision and respect matter more than volume. You follow up consistently until you get an answer.



Speaking opportunities: pitching hosts, and tracking every opportunity in our pipeline from first contact to booked talk.



Coordination: once a talk is booked, you own the logistics with the host: dates, materials, links, reminders, and post-talk follow-up.



LinkedIn content execution: turning our founder's talks and materials into LinkedIn posts using our templates and prompt system, and publishing on schedule. This is systematic, repeatable work: you follow the process, not your imagination.



Learning: attending a structured marketing coaching program alongside our Marketing Lead and completing the weekly assignments on time. The program teaches you the exact content system and prompts you'll be running.



You may occasionally support other marketing and team tasks as needed.



About you:



Your English is excellent, written and spoken. This is non-negotiable: you'll be writing to US business owners and event hosts every day as the voice of our brand, and joining live coaching sessions with a US-based coach. The final interview is conducted entirely in English and will test this directly.



You have real outreach experience where quality mattered more than volume: booking meetings, partnerships, or opportunities through researched, personalized contact. You know the difference between reaching the right ten people and blasting a thousand, and you can explain how you d
 who is worth contacting.



To be direct: if your outreach experience is mass messaging: sending the same template to hundreds of people and playing the numbers game, this role is not for you and we will screen for this in the interview. Quality of targeting beats volume of sending, every time.



You are the kind of person who runs the same playbook consistently every day without being chased, and follows a system exactly instead of improvising. You use AI tools in your daily work, or are genuinely eager to. Content or funnel experience is a plus, not a requirement. Bonus, not required: you can understand spoken Mandarin.



How to apply:



Include your resume, your expected monthly salary, and answers to the two questions below. We care about what you have actually done. Short, specific answers beat long generic ones. You're welcome to use AI to write; the interview will test your real-time English directly and we will follow up on your answers.



Tell me about a time you reached out to a specific person or organization that didn't know you, and got a yes: a speaking slot, a partnership, a booking, or a meeting with someone hard to reach. Why did you choose that specific person, how did you research them, what did your message say, and what happened? 3 to 5 sentences.

Tell me about a time you got people to actually show up: to an event, webinar, demo, or meeting. How many attended, and what did you do to get them there? Real numbers, 3 to 5 sentences.



Applications that do not answer both questions will automatically be excluded.



During the initial 3-month trial period, candidates will undergo training. Successful candidates will be offered a full-time, long-term position.



This position requires working 9am to 6pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday (9pm to 6am Manila time, Monday evening through Saturday morning). Please only apply if you are able and willing to work this schedule consistently long-term.



Success metrics during trial:



Every outreach target researched and pitched with a personalized message, follow-ups completed on schedule every working day. LinkedIn content published on schedule using our system, following the brand guideline with no exceptions. Speaking-opportunity pipeline updated weekly with new prospects. All coaching-program assignments completed on time.

title: Weekend Client Support Coordinator, US Furnished Housing (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
Built to sit on top of your weekday job

This is weekend work in your time zone, not just ours. If you are based in the Philippines you would work Saturday and Sunday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and have Monday through Friday completely free. We are looking specifically for someone who already has steady weekday work or study and wants a solid, predictable weekend engagement alongside it. If that is you, please say what your weekday commitment is when you apply. It is a positive, not a conflict.

We are not looking for someone to fill this while waiting for something full-time. These are our two busiest nights of the week and the person covering them matters more than the hours suggest. We would rather pay above market for someone who intends to stay.

Who we are

Haven Housing Solutions provides fully furnished turnkey housing across all 50 US states. Our residents are families displaced from their homes by fire, flood, or storm damage and placed with us by their insurance carrier, employees relocating for work, and government-placed occupants. When someone calls our after-hours line, they are usually having a difficult night in an unfamiliar home.

The role

You answer our after-hours line on US weekend nights, which are the busiest nights we have. You listen, capture exactly what is happening, and escalate to the right person on our internal team using a written procedure we train you on. Calls involve lockouts and access problems, no hot water or heat, water leaks and maintenance emergencies, appliance and utility failures, and weekend check-in and arrival questions, which are common on these particular shifts.

Call volume is low and most shifts are quiet. The remainder of the shift is spent on simple administrative work: data entry, updating records, organizing documents, and a short end-of-shift report. All of it is dropped the 
nt the phone rings.

Schedule

Shift begins (Pacific) Shift ends (Pacific) Your local day (Manila)

Friday 8:00 PM Saturday 5:00 AM Saturday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Saturday 8:00 PM Sunday 5:00 AM Sunday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

In short: Saturday and Sunday your time, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Monday through Friday completely free. 18 hours per week, fully paid. Pacific Time observes daylight saving, so from early November to mid-March your local window becomes 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Manila time. Your working days do not change.

Compensation and growth

USD $460 to $520 per month, paid monthly, depending on experience. That is a higher hourly rate than our full-time weekday role, deliberately, because these are our two busiest shifts. Independent contractor engagement. Paid training before you go live. Rate reviewed at 90 days.

This is a part-time role today and we are describing it honestly as one. As our portfolio grows we expect to add weekday administrative hours to this position, and we would much rather expand the hours of someone already trained on our systems than hire again. If you want a role that could grow into something larger over time, say so in your application.

What we require

• Clear, neutral, easily understood spoken English, and strong listening comprehension. A short voice recording is required with your application and it is the main thing we screen on.

• At least 2 years of customer service experience, including a minimum of 1 year on a live inbound voice queue. Chat and
 support alone does not qualify.

• Calm under pressure, and precision in recording an address, a callback number, and the real nature of a problem.

• The discipline to follow a written procedure exactly. See the note below on what this role does not do.

• A quiet, dedicated workspace, a noise-cancelling USB headset, and wired broadband at minimum 25 Mbps down and 10 Mbps up, on a Windows or macOS laptop or desktop with at least 8 GB of RAM.

• Backup power (UPS, minimum 2 hours) AND backup internet (mobile data or pocket WiFi). Both mandatory. We will ask you to verify them before making an offer.

Preferred, not required

• Property management, residential leasing, maintenance coordination, corporate housing, or serviced apartment experience

• Insurance claims or temporary housing coordination experience

• Familiarity with AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, Rent Manager, or similar

• Conversational Spanish

What this role does NOT do

You gather information and escalate. You do not diagnose problems, estimate repair costs, promise arrival times, state what is covered, or accept responsibility on our behalf. When a resident asks when someone is coming, the answer is that you are connecting them with our on-call team now. Following the procedure exactly matters more to us than sounding reassuring, and we test for it in the interview.

How to apply

All three items are required.

4. Your CV or resume, with inbound voice or call center roles clearly identified.

5. A voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds. First read this exactly: "Good evening, thank you for calling the Haven Housing after-hours line, this is [your name], may I please have the property address and a phone number where I can reach you?" Then, unscripted, tell us about a time you handled an upset customer and what you actually said.

6. In writing, briefly: (a) Confirm you can work Saturday and Sunday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM Manila time, and that this becomes 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM from November to March. Tell us what your weekday commitment is, if you have one. (b) Describe your internet, backup power, and backup internet. (c) A resident calls at 2:00 AM saying water is coming out from under the water heater and spreading across the floor. Walk us through exactly what you would do and say.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
The Finance Administrator is responsible for maintaining accurate day-to-day financial records for assigned entities within the organisation. The role supports financial operations through transaction processing, accounts receivable and payable management, VAT tracking, and assisting with monthly financial reporting.



The Finance Administrator works closely with the Financial Manager and broader finance team to ensure compliance, financial accuracy, and efficient financial administration.



Key Responsibilities



2.1 Daily Transaction & Cashbook Management

Record and allocate daily financial transactions across multiple cashbooks including main accounts and credit cards.

Ensure accurate General Ledger (GL), brand, department, and VAT allocations.

Import bank statements and maintain daily bank reconciliation updates.

Reconcile and balance cashbooks across multiple entities.

Manage billing queries, recoveries, and ad-hoc financial requests.

Support management with financial information and operational requests where required.

Maintain accuracy of cash flow projections and closing balances.



2.2 Debtors and Creditors Management

Accounts Receivable (Debtors)

Generate invoices based on management requests and ClickUp instructions.

Allocate receipts and reconcile debtor accounts.

Manage debtor queries, discrepancies, and requests.

Run AR statements and follow up on collections.

Accounts Payable (Creditors)

Capture supplier invoices accurately.

Allocate supplier payments.

Reconcile creditor accounts against external supplier statements.



2.3 VAT Tracking

Ensure correct VAT allocation on expenses where applicable.

Ensure all sales invoices include 15% VAT in accordance with SARS regulations.

Perform regular VAT control account checks.

Ensure compliance with SARS VAT guidelines.



2.4 Financial Reporting

Assist with the preparation of monthly management packs.

Support the preparation of financial reports used for company dashboards.

Utilize financial systems such as Xero and other reporting tools.

Identify and report potential financial risks and cost-saving opportunities.

Ensure accuracy, quality, and timely submission of financial reports.



2.5 Effective Teamwork and Self-Management

Manage personal workload and priorities to meet deliverables.

Follow lawful and reasonable instructions from the Financial Manager, COO, or CEO.

Collaborate effectively with finance team members to achieve shared goals.

Demonstrate and uphold company values.

Apply critical thinking and sound judgment when addressing financial matters.

title: HR Manager
description:
Job Description: Automotive Cold Caller / BDC Representative



Position Overview



We are looking for a motivated and resilient Automotive Cold Caller / Business Development Center Representative to contact prospective customers, follow up with older leads, and schedule appointments for our dealership’s sales team.



This is a hands-on outbound calling position. The successful candidate must be comfortable making a high volume of calls every day, speaking with customers in the United States, overcoming objections, and consistently following up with leads.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, highly disciplined, goal-oriented, and comfortable performing repetitive outreach.



Key Responsibilities



* Make a minimum of 100 outbound calls per working day.

* Contact new, inactive, and older leads from the dealership’s customer database.

* Re-engage customers who previously expressed interest in purchasing or financing a vehicle.

* Ask qualifying questions to understand the customer’s needs, budget, timeline, and vehicle preferences.

* Encourage qualified customers to visit the dealership or speak with a salesperson.

* Schedule appointments for the dealership’s sales team.

* Follow up with customers who do not answer or are not ready to proceed immediately.

* Respond professionally to objections and customer concerns.

* Maintain accurate notes and update every customer interaction in the CRM.

* Complete assigned follow-up tasks on time.

* Coordinate with the sales team regarding appointments, interested customers, and priority leads.

* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets.

* Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and performance meetings.



Performance Expectations



Performance will be measured using the following metrics:



* Number of outbound calls completed.

* Number of customers successfully contacted.

* Contact rate.

* Number of qualified leads generated.

* Number of appointments scheduled.

* Appointment show rate.

* Number of customers transferred to the sales team.

* CRM accuracy and completion of follow-up tasks.

* Sales generated from contacted leads.



Required Qualifications



* Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, lead generation, customer service, or automotive BDC work.

* Strong spoken English and the ability to communicate clearly with customers in the United States.

* Confident, friendly, and professional telephone manner.

* Comfortable making a high volume of calls every day.

* Able to handle rejection without losing motivation.

* Strong listening, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.

* Reliable internet connection, computer, headset, and quiet workspace.

* Good organisational and time-management skills.

* Ability to follow scripts while keeping conversations natural.

* Comfortable working with CRM systems, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.

* Able to work independently and remain productive with limited supervision.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience calling customers in the US, Canadian, UK, or Australian markets.

* Previous automotive dealership or BDC experience.

* Experience reactivating older or inactive leads.

* Experience scheduling sales appointments.

* Familiarity with vehicle sales, financing, trade-ins, or dealership operations.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position. Working hours must overlap with the dealership’s US business hours.



The employee will be expected to spend most of the working day actively calling and following up with customers.



Compensation



* Competitive fixed monthly salary.

* Performance-based bonuses may be offered for qualified appointments, attended appointments, or completed sales.

* Compensation will be discussed based on experience and demonstrated calling ability.



What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this role consistently completes the required call volume, keeps accurate CRM records, follows up persistently, generates qualified dealership appointments, and contributes directly to vehicle sales.

title: Digital Growth & Artist Operations Director (Christian Music Ministry)

Hello,



My name is Niki Vasilakis, and I’m looking for someone very special to partner with me.



This is more than a job. It’s an opportunity to help build a ministry through music.



For many years I have worked as a professional violinist, performing on concert stages and recording music. As my career has grown, so has a deeper sense of calling—to create music that brings people into places of peace, beauty, hope and the presence of God.



I believe music has the power to quiet anxious hearts, comfort people in grief, inspire worship, and point people towards something eternal.



I want to spend my life creating that kind of music.



To do that well, I need someone who is passionate about helping that music reach the people who need it most.



I’m praying for someone who loves Jesus, believes that excellence honours God, and sees digital media as a powerful tool for ministry.



The Vision



The vision is to build an international online presence centred around music that brings healing, hope and peace to people around the world.



This includes:



* Beautiful violin recordings

* Cinematic instrumental music

* Worship-inspired music

* Concert films

* Devotional and reflective content

* Storytelling through music

* Resources that nurture the soul of artists

* Future creative projects that point people towards beauty, hope and the love of Christ



Every recording, every video and every project is created with the desire that someone, somewhere, would encounter hope through music.



The Role



I’m looking for a Digital Growth & Artist Operations Director to become my long-term strategic partner.



This is not an artist management role.



You won’t be booking concerts, managing performances or representing me professionally.



Instead, your mission is to ensure that every piece of music and every creative project reaches the widest possible audience online.



You will oversee the digital side of the ministry by helping manage and grow:



* My website

* Spotify

* Apple Music

* Amazon Music

* YouTube

* Instagram

*

* TikTok

*
 newsletters

* Digital catalogue management

* Playlist pitching

* Radio promotion

* Christian radio promotion

* Sync licensing submissions

* Search engine optimisation

* Metadata and discoverability

* Analytics and audience growth



You’ll help build systems that allow the music to travel further than I could ever do on my own.



What I’m Looking For



I’m looking for someone who:



* Has a genuine relationship with Jesus Christ.

* Sees their work as ministry.

* Loves music and believes it can bring healing and hope.

* Is highly organised and detail-oriented.

* Enjoys digital strategy and problem solving.

* Thinks long-term rather than chasing short-term trends.

* Wants to build something meaningful over many years.

* Communicates with kindness, honesty and excellence.



Experience in music marketing, digital marketing or artist development would be wonderful, but just as important is a willingness to learn, a servant heart and a passion for helping meaningful work reach the world.

title: Director of Finance & Accounting
description:
Ready to lead the financial future of a brand with heart and purpose?

At Hadley Designs, we believe every product should fill homes with beauty, learning, and inspiration. We design screen-free learning tools that help children fall in love with learning and help parents feel proud of how they nurture that growth.



As our Director of Finance and Accounting, you’ll be the architect of scalable systems that fuel that mission. You’ll bring precision, foresight, and strategic clarity to every financial decision, guiding the company’s growth toward $100M and beyond with confidence and discipline.



You won’t just manage numbers. You’ll empower a purpose-driven team to think bigger, move faster, and build a lasting legacy.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand redefining early education through creativity, beauty, and connection. We design screen-free learning tools that spark curiosity and confidence in children while giving parents peace of mind.

We believe learning should be fun and engaging. Beautiful design creates better learning. We don’t just sell products. We shape futures.



About the Role

Your Core Focus

You’ll own the full finance function, building scalable systems, managing cash flow, driving profitability, and leading financial strategy to support Hadley Designs’ next era of growth.



What You’ll Do

1. Deliver accurate, audit-ready financials by the 20th of each month with full account reconciliation and zero material errors

2. Build and maintain a 12-month rolling cash forecast, updated weekly, ensuring perfect liquidity and visibility

3. Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process across all departments with ?10% variance between forecast and actual results

4. Develop automated systems and workflows that reduce manual reporting time by at least 25% within your first year

5. Partner with leadership to implement initiatives that increase profitability and improve EBITDA by 2 percentage points in your first 12 months

6. Create and document SOPs for close, forecasting, cash flow, and reporting processes

7. Implement new systems for expense management, travel, and purchasing by Month 6

8. Produce insightful financial dashboards and KPIs that drive better decision-making

9. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Operations to align growth, cash flow, and inventory planning

10. Evaluate technology solutions (ERP, reporting tools) that prepare the company for scale



How Success Is Measured

- 100% of monthly financials delivered on time and error-free

- 0 overdrafts, late fees, or missed payments

- ?10% variance between forecasted and actual EBITDA

- 12-month rolling cash forecast maintained weekly

- SOPs for all finance processes documented within 3 months

- System improvements reducing manual work by 25% in Year 1

- Trailing-12-month EBITDA margin up 2 points within first year



Who You Are

You’re a strategic, detail-oriented leader who thrives on clarity, accuracy, and impact. You know how to scale systems, guide teams through growth, and communicate financial insight in plain English. You’re not just reporting numbers, you’re building the foundation for smart, sustainable expansion.



You bring:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (MBA or CPA strongly preferred)

- 5+ years of progressive experience in finance or accounting, including 3+ years in leadership

- Proven success in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling

- Experience implementing scalable systems and automation in growing organizations

- Strong knowledge of GAAP, compliance, and tax standards

- Proficiency with tools such as Xero, QuickBooks, or advanced Excel/Google Sheets

- Excellent analytical and communication skills; you turn complexity into clarity

- Experience in e-commerce or multi-channel retail (preferred)

- Collaborative mindset and the confidence to influence executive-level decisions



Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Hadley Designs, your work has purpose. You’ll join a small but mighty remote-first team where financial excellence and creativity go hand in hand. You’ll have the freedom to build, lead, and innovate, without red tape.



Here’s what you can expect:

- Remote-first environment with flexible hours

- Direct collaboration with the CEO and leadership team

- Autonomy and trust in how you structure your work

- Paid time off and holidays

- Learning opportunities and leadership development support

- Access to Hadley Designs products for your family

- A decade of stability and growth as a family-founded, purpose-driven brand

title: Real Estate Short-Form Video Producer (Premiere / CapCut) — Independent, High-Volume
description:
I run a real estate brand in Hamilton, Ontario, and I produce a high volume of short-form vertical video for listings (Reels, TikTok, Shorts). I record a lot of raw footage and I need someone to take it from there — I don't want to organize it, sort it, or touch a timeline.



Here's the actual workflow: I batch-record on my phone and dump everything raw into a shared Dropbox folder — no labels, no structure. Your job is to open that folder, figure out what's a hook (the opening line), what's the meat (the property/value content), and what's a CTA (the "comment [word] for details" ending), and then assemble large batches of finished videos by mixing and matching those pieces.



For a single listing I want dozens to hundreds of variations — different hooks paired with the meat, different CTAs, different editing styles — so we can post widely, see what performs organically, and put ad spend behind the winners. Roughly 2 listings a month, but each one is a big batch.



Every video needs captions — accurate, well-timed on-screen captions burned into the video, styled clean for vertical short-form. This is non-negotiable, so you need to be fast and accurate at captioning at volume.



You're a good fit if you:



Are genuinely independent — you can look at an unsorted folder and make smart assembly decisions without me directing each edit

Know Adobe Premiere (preferred) or CapCut (totally fine) and are fast at high-volume, template-style assembly

Can produce clean, accurate burned-in captions on every video, at volume

Have done short-form vertical video before — real estate a bonus, not required

Can turn around large batches reliably and keep files organized on your end



To apply:



Start your reply with the word GREYSTONE so I know you read this fully.

Send a portfolio or 2–3 sample short-form vertical videos you've edited (captioned samples preferred).

Answer this: I send you a Dropbox folder of 40 unlabeled clips and say "make me a batch." Walk me through exactly what you'd do first, how you'd handle captions across that many videos, and tell me what questions (if any) you'd ask me before starting.



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a small trial task (assembling a set of variations from a sample folder) before any ongoing work.

title: Packaging Artwork Specialist (Philippines)
description:
Packaging Artworker (Philippines)



Location: Philippines (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time Contractor

Reports to: Creative & Product Team



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Packaging Artworker to join our growing creative team. This is a highly detail-oriented production role responsible for taking approved packaging designs and turning them into flawless, print-ready artwork for manufacturers across the UK, US, Europe and Australia.



This is not a graphic design role. Instead, we're looking for someone who understands the technical side of packaging production and can ensure every file is accurate, compliant, and ready for commercial printing.



Experience working with consumer packaged goods (CPG), supplements, beverages, food, or FMCG brands is highly preferred.



 Responsibilities



Prepare final print-ready artwork for packaging across multiple product formats including:



  * Cans

  * Cartons

  * Flexible packaging

  * Labels

  * Pouches

  * Sachets

  * Display boxes

* Build artwork from approved creative concepts while ensuring all technical print requirements are met.

* Create and maintain accurate dielines supplied by manufacturers.

* Set up correct:



  * Bleeds

  * Safe zones

  * Trim areas

  * Overprint settings

  * Spot colours

  * White ink layers

  * Varnish layers

  * Emboss/deboss layers

* Prepare files for a variety of printing methods including:



  * Offset lithographic

  * Flexographic

  * Digital

  * Plate printing (highly desirable)

* Ensure all files meet printer specifications before production.

* Carry out thorough pre-flight checks before artwork is released.

* Update packaging for regulatory, nutritional and legal changes across different markets.

* Manage artwork version control and maintain organised file structures.

* Work closely with suppliers, packaging manufacturers and internal teams to resolve technical artwork issues.

* Review printer proofs and support colour approvals where required.







Essential



* 3+ years' experience producing commercial print artwork.

* Strong experience preparing packaging for print.

* Advanced Adobe Illustrator skills.

* Excellent understanding of:



  * Bleeds

  * Dielines

  * Trim marks

  * Safe areas

  * Colour separations

  * CMYK

  * Pantone spot colours

  * Overprint

  * Knockout

  * Rich black

* Experience producing print-ready PDFs.

* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to identify small production errors before files go to print.

* Comfortable working with multiple SKUs, product variants and packaging updates.

* Excellent written English.



### Highly Desirable



* Experience producing packaging for UK and US consumer brands.

* Experience within:



  * Supplements

  * Beverage

  * Food

  * Health & wellness

  * FMCG

* Knowledge of packaging regulations and mandatory packaging information.

* Experience working directly with overseas manufacturers.

* Understanding of plate printing, flexographic printing and print cylinder requirements.

* Experience with colour management and print proofing.

* Familiarity with GS1 barcodes and QR code placement.

* Experience preparing artwork for aluminium cans, flexible pouches and folding cartons.



Software



* Adobe Illustrator (Expert)

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Acrobat Pro

* Adobe InDesign (nice to have)



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys the technical side of packaging production. They notice inconsistencies that others miss and understand how seemingly minor artwork issues can become costly production mistakes. They thrive in a fast-paced environment, can manage multiple packaging updates simultaneously, and take pride in delivering accurate, production-ready files every time.



Bonus Experience



* Packaging for major retailers (Target, Walmart, Tesco, Boots, etc.)

* Working with supplement or beverage manufacturers

* Multi-language packaging

* FDA and UK/EU packaging compliance

* Experience with colour standards and Pantone matching

* Understanding of packaging production from concept through to final print



This role would suit someone who has worked as a Packaging Artworker, Production Artist, Pre-Press Specialist, or Packaging Production Designer, and who is passionate about delivering technically flawless artwork ready for commercial production.

title: *GoHighLevel Tech VA (Funnels, Workflows, Automations) - Part-Time, Night Shift
description:
**READ THE HOURS BEFORE YOU APPLY. This is a night shift.**



Apply at this link: 



You need at least 3 working hours between 10pm and 4am Philippine Time, every weekday. That's how we overlap with our US morning. If you can't work nights, don't apply. We'd rather you skip this one than burn out in month 2.



**About us**



LSAT Unplugged is a US-based LSAT coaching and law school admissions company. We've been helping students raise their test scores since 2005. We run lean: a small team, a lot of automation, and systems that need to keep working while we focus on students.



**The role**



You'll be our hands-on tech assistant, working directly with our founder and supporting our tech lead and operations manager. This isn't a build-from-scratch engineering role. You're the person who keeps our marketing and operations machine running: setting up
 campaigns, updating sales pages, fixing the automation that broke, and catching problems before students notice them.



Most tasks are small and specific. A typical week: schedule a launch
 sequence, swap testimonials on a checkout page, figure out why a lead got the wrong text message, update our automations library so the next person can see how things work.



**Hard requirement: GoHighLevel**



You must already know GoHighLevel well. Funnels, workflows, calendars, products,
 and SMS. Not "I watched some tutorials." Not "I can learn it fast." You've built in it, broken things in it, and fixed them. This is the tool you'll live in, and we don't have time to teach it. If GHL isn't on your resume, this role isn't for you.



**Hard requirement 2: you use AI to do the work**



This is not a bonus point. It's how the job gets done.



We expect you to use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or whatever you already like, as your default way of working. Especially on website and sales page updates. Instead of hand-coding a section, you describe it and iterate. Instead of clicking through 40 pages hunting for broken links, you run a script. Instead of eyeballing a mobile layout that broke, you paste the CSS in and ask why.



Real examples of what we mean:



- We hand you a Google Doc of copy. You turn it into a publish-ready GHL funnel page that matches our fonts and colors, using AI to write the HTML and CSS for the custom code blocks.

- A section looks wrong on mobile. You screenshot it, work the CSS out with AI, test it, ship it.

- We change a URL structure. You generate the redirect map instead of writing 60 redirects by hand.

- You need to check every page on the site for broken links and missing images. You write a script once and rerun it monthly.

- A popup needs to fire on exit intent for one traffic source only. You work out the trigger logic with AI rather than waiting on our developer.



You don't need to be a developer. You need to be someone who reaches for AI first, reads what it gives you, tests it, and fixes it when it's wrong. If your answer to "can you build this page section" is "I'd need a developer," this isn't the role.



To be clear about one thing: we want you using AI on the work. We don't want AI pretending to be you. More on that in the application.



Apply at this link: 



**What you'll do**



Core responsibilities:



1.
 and SMS campaign setup. Build, schedule, and update sequences in GoHighLevel. Swap dates, links, and copy before launches.

2. Website and sales page updates, AI-assisted. Website edits, GHL funnel and checkout pages, redirects, broken links and images, popups, and publishing new pages from content we provide. You'll use AI to write and fix the HTML and CSS rather than waiting on a developer or clicking through a page builder for 3 hours.

3. AI bot changes. Adjust prompts and flows on our GHL conversation bots and voice agent when they need tuning.

4. Automation library updates. Document new workflows and keep our internal library current.

5. Automation QA and monitoring. Test workflows end to end, run recurring checks, and investigate when something fires wrong or doesn't fire at all.

6. GHL
 deliverability. Domain health, SPF and DKIM, spam placement investigations, list hygiene.

7. Small scripts and automations. Use Claude Code or a similar tool to build the thing that saves you 2 hours next month.



You'll also pitch in on:



1. CRM and data hygiene in GHL: tags, smartlists, custom fields, duplicate and spam contact cleanup.

2. Google Sheets maintenance: formula fixes, mapping GHL data to trackers, backups.

3. Checkout and product plumbing: creating and cloning GHL and Thinkific checkout pages, basic Stripe product edits, price changes.

4. First-line tech triage: "the site is down," "a student can't log in," "why did she get this
." Diagnose, fix, or escalate.

5. Owning projects end to end. Sometimes we'll hand you a whole project, not a task list. You scope it, break it down, manage your own deadlines, and keep us posted without being chased.



**Tools we use**



You must be strong in GoHighLevel, and you must already work with AI daily.



Basic HTML and CSS helps a lot here. You don't need to write it fro
mory. You need to be able to read what AI hands you, spot what's wrong, and fix it.



You should be comfortable with, or able to pick up quickly: WordPress, Zapier, 
, Thinkific, Stripe, and Google Sheets. We also touch ManyChat, Typeform, Calendly, Slack, and Asana.



Apply at this link: 



**Who does well in this role**



1. You debug before you escalate. When an automation misfires, your first instinct is to open the workflow and trace it, not to ask what to do.

2. You test your own work. Every link clicked, every workflow run end to end, before you mark a task done.

3. You write clearly and fast in English. We work async through Asana and Slack, so your writing is how we know you.

4. You're organized enough to handle 10 to 20 small tasks a week without dropping any.

5. You can project manage yourself. Hand you a project and you come back with a plan, then updates, then a finished result.

6. You reach for AI before you reach for us. When a page section needs building or a layout breaks, your first move is to work it out with AI, not to send a question and wait 12 hours for an answer.

7. You don't trust AI blindly. You check the output, click the links, and load the page on your phone before you say it's done.



**Details**



1. 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow if it's a fit

2. $450 to $650 USD per month, depending on experience

3. Fully remote and async-first, but you need at least 3 working hours between 10pm and 4am Philippine Time so you're available for meetings

4. **Hubstaff time tracking is required.** You track your hours in Hubstaff while you work. This is not optional and it's not negotiable. If you're not willing to track time, stop reading here.

5. Paid every 2 weeks based on tracked Hubstaff hours

6. Independent contractor role

7. Long-term. We're not looking for a 3-month project.



**How to apply**



Apply at this link: 



The form takes about 10 minutes and ends with a short video. Yes, a video is required. It's a 3 minute recording of you talking about your GHL and AI work, with your screen shared. No video, no interview. That's the whole filter.



One note, since we're asking for two things that sound opposite. Use AI on the job as much as you want, that's the point of the role. Don't use it to answer for you in the application. We want to hear you talk about work you actually did, in your own words, with your screen up. Polish isn't what we're grading.



If the video is a dealbreaker for you, that's fine, this just isn't your role.

title: Overnight Client Support Coordinator, Furnished Housing (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the shift, because this is the part people get wrong

This is billed as an overnight role because our clients are in the United States. If you are based in the Philippines, it is a normal daytime shift on a normal working week: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM Manila time, Monday through Friday, with Saturday and Sunday off. You will not be working nights and you will not be working weekends. Please read the schedule table below before applying.

Who we are

Haven Housing Solutions provides fully furnished turnkey housing across all 50 US states. Our residents are people in transition: families displaced from their homes by fire, flood, or storm damage and placed with us by their insurance carrier, employees relocating for work, and government-placed occupants. When someone calls us at 2:00 AM, they are usually having a bad night in an unfamiliar home. How that call is handled matters enormously, to them and to us.

The role

You are the voice on the other end of our after-hours line. You answer, you listen, you capture exactly what is happening, and you escalate it to the right person on our internal team using a written escalation procedure we will train you on.

Typical calls include:

• A resident cannot get into the property or the door code is not working

• No hot water, no heat, no air conditioning

• An active water leak, a plumbing backup, or a maintenance emergency

• Appliance failures, power or utility problems, WiFi issues

• Check-in and check-out questions, arrival timing, keys and access

• Questions we cannot answer overnight, which get logged and routed for the morning

Call volume is genuinely low. Most nights are quiet. That is by design, and it is why the rest of your shift is spent on straightforward administrative work: data entry, updating property and occupant records, organizing and filing documents, preparing lease paperwork, maintaining vendor contact lists, tidying shared inboxes, and writing a short end-of-shift report. None of it is urgent, and all of it gets dropped the instant the phone rings. The phone always wins.

Schedule

Shift begins (Pacific) Shift ends (Pacific) Your local day (Manila)

Sunday 8:00 PM Monday 5:00 AM Monday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Monday 8:00 PM Tuesday 5:00 AM Tuesday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Tuesday 8:00 PM Wednesday 5:00 AM Wednesday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Wednesday 8:00 PM Thursday 5:00 AM Thursday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Thursday 8:00 PM Friday 5:00 AM Friday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

In short: Monday through Friday your time, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM, with Saturday and Sunday off. 45 hours per week, fully paid, with flexible breaks taken during quiet stretches. Note: Pacific Time observes daylight saving, so from early November to mid-March your local window becomes 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Manila time. Your working days do not change.

Compensation

USD $900 to $1,150 per month, paid monthly, depending on experience. Independent contractor engagement. Two weeks of paid training before you go live. Rate is reviewed at 90 days.

What we require

• Clear, neutral, easily understood spoken English. A US resident in a stressful 
nt needs to understand you the first time, and you need to understand them the first time. Strong listening comprehension matters as much as pronunciation. See the application instructions below: a short voice recording is required, and this is the main thing we screen on.

• At least 2 years of customer service experience, including a minimum of 1 year on a live inbound voice queue. Chat and
 support alone does not qualify for this role.

• Calm under pressure. You will speak with people who are frustrated, upset, or frightened, sometimes at 3:00 AM their time. We are looking for steady, not scripted-cheerful.

• Precision. Getting an address, a callback number, and the actual nature of a problem recorded correctly the first time is most of this job.

• The discipline to follow a procedure exactly. See the section below on what this role does not do. This is not a preference, it is the core requirement.

• A quiet, dedicated workspace with no background noise, and a noise-cancelling USB headset.

• Wired broadband, minimum 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload. A laptop or desktop running Windows or macOS with at least 8 GB of RAM. Mobile phones and tablets are not sufficient.

• Backup power (a UPS with at least 2 hours of runtime) AND a backup internet connection (mobile data or pocket WiFi). Both are mandatory, not optional. You are our only line of contact during your shift, and we will ask you to verify these with photos or specifications before we make an offer.

Preferred, not required

• Experience in property management, residential leasing, maintenance coordination, corporate housing, short-term or furnished rentals, or serviced apartments

• Experience in insurance claims support, temporary housing, or additional living expense (ALE) coordination

• Familiarity with property management software such as AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, Rent Manager, or similar

• Conversational Spanish

To be clear about what we mean: general real estate sales or cold-calling experience is much less relevant here than experience helping a tenant with a broken water heater. Tell us about the second kind.

What this role does NOT do, and why we are telling you up front

You gather information and you escalate. You do not diagnose the problem, estimate what a repair will cost, promise when a technician will arrive, say whether something is covered, or accept responsibility on our behalf. When a resident asks when someone is coming, the correct answer is that you are connecting them with our on-call team right now, not a time you have guessed at.

This matters more than it may sound. We sit between the property owner and the resident, and a well-meant promise made at 2:00 AM can create a real problem for the resident, the owner, and us. Following the procedure exactly, every single time, is worth more to us than sounding reassuring. We will test for this in the interview, and the answer we are looking for is the disciplined one, not the helpful-sounding one.

How to apply

Applications without all three items will not be reviewed. This takes about ten minutes and it is the same for everyone.

1. Your CV or resume, with the inbound voice or call center roles clearly identified, including the queue type and rough call volume.

2. A voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds. Use any phone or computer. First, read this sentence exactly as written: "Good evening, thank you for calling the Haven Housing after-hours line, this is [your name], may I please have the property address and a phone number where I can reach you?" Then, in your own words and without a script, tell us about a time you handled an upset customer and what you actually said to them. We want to hear both your prepared voice and your natural one.

3. Answer these three questions in writing, briefly: (a) Confirm you can work 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM Manila time, Monday through Friday, and that you understand this becomes 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM from November to March. (b) Describe your internet connection, your backup power, and your backup internet. (c) A resident calls at 2:00 AM and says water is coming out from under the water heater and spreading across the floor. Walk us through exactly what you would do and say, step by step.

Question (c) is the one we read most carefully. There is a right answer and it is not complicated, but it is not the obvious one either.

Shortlisted candidates will have a live call during the actual shift hour, so we can hear you at the time of day you would really be working.

title: Senior Estimator (Electrical) - Australia
description:
Join an Australian electrical contracting and estimating firm working on some of the country's most complex projects, from data centres to hospitals, all from the comfort of home. This is a stable, long-term role with a genuine growth path for an experienced estimator who takes pride in precision.



Role Summary

This role owns the full take-off and estimating process for cable containment systems across large, technically complex projects. You will interpret detailed electrical drawings, containment schedules, specifications and revisions, converting them into accurate, traceable and quote-ready bills of materials. Day to day, this means measuring cable tray, ladder and wire basket systems, reconciling contractor schedules against drawings, and maintaining clear assumptions and clarification registers. You will work closely with estimating, sales and technical teams to resolve queries and finalise quotations, sitting at the centre of the pre-quotation process where accuracy and clear documentation are critical.

Key Responsibilities

• Complete detailed take-offs for large and technically complex projects, including data centres, hospitals and industrial facilities

• Measure cable tray, cable ladder, wire basket and associated containment systems

• Identify straight lengths, bends, tees, crosses, reducers, risers, covers, dividers, splice plates and accessories

• Calculate trapeze supports, cantilever supports, threaded rod, fixings and associated hardware

• Separate systems by type, width, finish, floor, zone and fire rating requirement

• Reconcile contractor schedules against drawings and specifications

• Identify discrepancies, duplicated quantities, missing items and scope gaps

• Review drawing addenda and maintain accurate revision control

• Produce clearly marked-up drawings so every quantity can be independently verified

• Prepare quote-ready bills of materials in line with company product codes and estimating standards

• Maintain comprehensive assumptions, exclusions and clarification registers

• Liaise with estimating, sales and technical teams to resolve queries and finalise quotations

What We Are Looking For

• At least 5 years' experience in electrical, MEP or cable-containment estimating

• Experience working on data centres, hospitals, industrial facilities or other technically complex projects

• Strong knowledge of cable tray, cable ladder, wire basket and containment support systems

• Ability to interpret electrical plans, sections, schematics, schedules and specifications

• Experience reconciling conflicting information across multiple project documents

• Strong digital take-off and drawing mark-up capabilities, with advanced Microsoft Excel skills

• Strong attention to detail and the confidence to raise technical questions rather than make unsupported assumptions

• Proficiency with a recognised digital take-off platform such as ProEst, Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit or PlanSwift

• Experience with AutoCAD, Revit or Navisworks highly regarded

• Excellent written and spoken English

Requirements

title: DME Billing Specialist
description:
DME Billing Specialist 



Employment Type: Full Time 

Experience Level: Mid Level (2 to 4 years) 

Department: Revenue Cycle Management / Billing 

Reports To: Billing Manager or RCM Supervisor



We are seeking an experienced DME Billing Specialist to manage the full billing cycle for durable medical equipment claims. This role is responsible for accurate claim submission, denial resolution, and compliance with Medicare DMEPOS and private payer requirements. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with HCPCS coding, CMN documentation, and payer specific billing rules for DME.



Key Responsibilities

Prepare and submit clean claims to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers for DME items including HCPCS Level II coding

Verify insurance eligibility and benefits prior to billing and confirm coverage criteria under Medicare DMEPOS policy

Obtain and track Certificates of Medical Necessity (CMNs) and Detailed Written Orders (DWOs) required for reimbursement

Manage prior authorization requests and track approval status through payer portals

Apply appropriate modifiers such as KX, GA, GY, and GZ based on medical necessity documentation and ABN status

Monitor claim status through clearinghouses and resolve rejections before resubmission deadlines

Post payments and reconcile ERA/EOB documents against expected reimbursement rates

Identify and appeal denied claims within payer timely filing limits, drafting appeal letters supported by medical records

Stay current with Medicare Administrative Contractor (MAC) local coverage determinations (LCDs) for the applicable jurisdiction

Track Competitive Bidding Program requirements for applicable product categories and zip codes

Maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations when handling protected health information

Collaborate with intake, sales, and clinical staff to ensure documentation supports billed items

Meet monthly targets for days in accounts receivable, denial rate, and clean claim rate



Required Qualifications

2 to 4 years of experience in DME billing or durable medical equipment revenue cycle

Working knowledge of HCPCS Level II coding, ICD 10 CM, and CPT as applied to DME claims

Understanding of Medicare DMEPOS Supplier Standards and PECOS enrollment requirements

Experience with CMN forms, Advance Beneficiary Notices (ABNs), and prior authorization workflows

Familiarity with major DME billing software (Brightree, Fastrack, HME/DME specific platforms) or equivalent

Knowledge of clearinghouse claim submission and rejection resolution

Strong understanding of denial management and appeals process across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers

High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate degree in health information management, billing and coding, or related field preferred



Preferred Qualifications

Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Billing and Coding Specialist (CBCS) credential

Experience with Medicare jurisdictions and current MAC assignments (CGS, Noridian)

Experience auditing claims for compliance with LCDs and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs)

Working knowledge of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program and single payment amounts



Work Environment

This position is remote with standard business hours. 

Compensation - $5/hour

description:

This project needs to be completed within 7 calendar days.



Please do NOT apply if you only have basic Airtable experience. We need someone who is already advanced and can begin immediately.



WHAT WE ARE BUILDING



Airtable will become a central database for our vehicle fleet and needs to be designed to eventually support 100–500+ vehicles.



The system will track:



Vehicle master records

VIN / year / make / model / mileage

Vehicle status

Vehicle acquisitions

Purchase information

Financing and loans

Vehicle valuations

Fleet equity

Revenue by vehicle

Maintenance and repairs

Insurance

Titles and registration

Vehicle performance

Expected exit/sale dates

Management alerts and dashboards



We already have much of our business logic, rules, and desired information established.



We need an expert who can take this information and turn it into a clean, scalable and automated Airtable system.



AIRTABLE EXPERTISE REQUIRED



You MUST be highly experienced with:



Airtable database architecture

Relational database design

Linked records

Lookups

Rollups

Advanced formulas

Airtable Automations

Airtable Interfaces

Forms

Conditional logic

Dashboards/reporting

Scalable database design



We do NOT want everything placed into one giant table.



The system should properly connect areas such as:



Vehicles ? Acquisitions ? Financing ? Maintenance ? Revenue ? Valuations ? Disposition



INTEGRATIONS ARE VERY IMPORTANT



You must also understand how to connect Airtable with external systems.



Experience should include:



Airtable API

REST APIs

Webhooks

Make

Zapier

JSON/data mapping

API authentication

Automated data syncing

Trigger-based workflows



You should be comfortable reading API documentation and determining how outside software can communicate with Airtable.



We may eventually connect Airtable with our:



Rental management software

Accounting/financial systems

Vehicle valuation sources

CRM

Payment systems

Other business platforms



You should understand how to determine the source of truth, prevent duplicate data, and create reliable automated workflows.



7-DAY PROJECT TIMELINE



The core Airtable system must be completed within 7 calendar days from project start.



You must:



Be available to start immediately

Have significant availability during the next 7 days

Work independently

Communicate progress consistently

By the end of the project, we expect the core system to include:



Database architecture

Revenue/performance tracking

Vehicle valuation tracking

Proper linked relationships

Key automations

Structure for future integrations

Basic system documentation



Complex integrations requiring external API approval or third-party access may continue after the initial 7-day build, but the database must be integration-ready from Day 1.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



Is an Airtable expert

Has personally built complex Airtable systems

Understands database architecture

Understands APIs and integrations

Can build with Make and/or Zapier

Can think through business workflows

Can recommend better technical solutions when necessary

Works quickly

HOW TO APPLY

: 
 



Start your application with the word:



FLEET in the subject line

How many years have you worked with Airtable?

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:

mbers are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our tea
mbers to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 2 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

title: Director of Recruitment and People Operations
description:
Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.



Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?



At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of Recruitment People Operations to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.



Our Mission:



We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.



Our Vision:



We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.



Role Overview



As the Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.



This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).



Key Responsibilities



Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

• Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.

• Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.



People Operations:

• People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align

ed with the company's growth objectives.

• Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.

• Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.

• Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

• Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.

• External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.



How Success Is Measured (two bold sub-headers, each with bullets):



Talent Acquisition KPIs:

• Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days.

• Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants.

• Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time.

• Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+.

• Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year.



People Operations KPIs:

• Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale.

• Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement.

• Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment.

• Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.



Who you are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are equally comfortable defending the company on Glassdoor as you are building a 90-day onboarding plan. You thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first, contractor-centric environment and have a track record of both filling open roles ahead of timeline and scaling the people systems that retain the talent you bring in.



Talent Acquisition / Recruiting (must-haves):

• 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or e-commerce organizations.

• Proven track record of hiring across marketing, ops, Amazon, product, and leadership roles.

• Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and group interviews.

• Familiarity with recruiting tech stacks: LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, OnlineJobs.ph.

• Comfortable managing hiring systems using Notion, ClickUp, or lightweight ATS tools.

• Strong writing ability: clear job posts, compelling outreach, direct candidate comms.

• Ability to handle 5-10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process.

• Experience defending brand reputation and responding to feedback (e.g. Glassdoor).

• Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics.



People Operations (must-haves):

• 5+ years of progressive HR or people operations experience, with leadership responsibility.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

• Direct experience operating contractor-centric or distributed teams.

• Demonstrated success building compliant, scalable people systems.

• Strong understanding of contractor classification, employment law, and risk mitigation.

*Develop and maintain estimating templates, rate libraries and pricing databases

title: Commercial Real Estate Administrative Coordinator
description:
About



This role sits inside a busy commercial real estate practice that helps business owners buy, sell, and lease the spaces they run their companies from: storefronts, warehouses, and offices. You will support one high-producing agent, keeping transactions, marketing, research, and client communication organized so deals close on time and nothing gets missed.

This is dedicated, full-time work designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth. You will become a trusted operational partner to the agent, with room to deepen your commercial real estate expertise over time.



Responsibilities

•	Transaction coordination: Move deals from listing to closing, tracking timelines, contingencies, and compliance documents. Prepare LOIs, PSAs, and lease paperwork. Coordinate with escrow, title, lenders, and attorneys, and keep clean digital files for every transaction.

•	CRM and database: Keep RealNex and KW Command current and accurate. Tag contacts correctly, track prospects and active deals, and support pipeline reporting.

•	Research: Run property searches for buyer and tenant clients using commercial platforms. Help prepare Broker Opinions of Value and compile lease and sales comparables.

•	Marketing and listings: Coordinate marketing campaigns and
 sends. Help build offering memorandums, flyers, and presentations. Support social media scheduling and keep listings accurate across platforms.

•	Operations: Manage the agent's calendar and meetings, track deadlines and recurring tasks, organize files in Google Drive, and coordinate outside vendors.

•	Expect a proactive week that mixes recurring workflows with ad-hoc requests: you might track a closing deadline in the morning, pull property comps in the afternoon, and update the CRM before logging off.

•	Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and daily work.



Qualifications

•	3 or more years in administrative or operations work (must-have).

•	Experience supporting a US-based real estate agent (must-have).

•	Real, verifiable commercial real estate experience directly supporting a commercial broker, not just general commercial exposure (must-have). You should know the difference between property types (industrial, office, retail, flex, mixed-use), understand landlord rep vs. tenant rep, and know what a lease comp actually means: active listings used for comparison purposes, not closed transactions.

•	Hands-on experience managing a CRM (must-have).

•	Proven experience using AI for automations, research, drafting, and workflows (must-have). This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

•	Strong organization, time management, and written communication (must-have).

•	Close attention to detail and the ability to run several projects at once (must-have).

•	Comfort working independently with light supervision (must-have).

•	Transaction coordination experience preferred. Full-cycle deal experience is the target; if not full-cycle, some hands-on deal experience in leasing or sales is expected, not just back-end document organization.

•	Firsthand experience preparing a BOV or offering memorandum strongly preferred. You should be able to describe deliverables you built, not just recognize the terms.

•	Familiarity with commercial real estate data platforms preferred.



Tools You'll Use

•	Commercial real estate platforms: Crexi, CoStar, LoopNet (must-have), plus Moody's Catylist and Brevitas.

•	CRM and transaction tools: RealNex (must-have), KW Command, and AIR CRE forms (must-have).

•	Prospecting and mapping: Terrakotta and BatchGeo.

•	Collaboration and files: Zoom, Slack, and Google Drive (must-have).

You do not need to know all of these on day one, but you should be able to learn new software quickly.





Benefits

•	Competitive salary

•	Paid US holidays

•	Paid wellness days

•	Health and wellness allowance

•	Monthly profit sharing

•	Long-term placement with real growth

•	Continuous upskilling in AI and the craft of commercial real estate operations

•	Dedicated success coaching and support

Most videos will be short-form real estate, mortgage, educational, and personal-brand content. Some will be relatively simple edits, while others will require more creative effects.



???? **Compensation:** Please send your rate for 10–15 videos per week or your preferred monthly rate.

5. What editing software you use



?? **Please do not apply without a portfolio.**



I’m looking for someone I can work with consistently and potentially grow with long-term. Creativity matters just as much as technical editing ability.
