title: Social Media Carousel Designer
description:
I’m looking for a creative graphic designer to help grow my personal brand through visually compelling, easy-to-read social media carousels.



My content focuses on entrepreneurship, startups, technology, unconventional career pivots, building companies and my experiences as a founder and former professional athlete.



The goal is not simply to create attractive graphics. Each carousel should tell a clear story, keep people swiping and encourage saves, shares, comments and profile visits.



I will usually provide the topic, written content, rough slide structure and supporting photos. You will transform these materials into polished carousels that feel distinctive, editorial and native to social media.



## What you’ll be designing



* Founder-storytelling carousels

* Personal stories and career-pivot content

* Educational startup and entrepreneurship posts

* Opinion-led and thought-leadership carousels

* Lists, frameworks and lessons learned

* Photo-led personal-brand carousels

* LinkedIn document posts

* Instagram carousel posts

* Occasional quote graphics, charts or visual explainers



## Responsibilities



* Design engaging LinkedIn and Instagram carousels

* Turn written content into a clear visual story

* Create strong cover slides that make people stop scrolling

* Build layouts that encourage readers to continue swiping

* Establish a consistent and recognizable personal-brand style

* Use typography, spacing, hierarchy and imagery effectively

* Select and edit suitable photos, screenshots and visual elements

* Create simple illustrations, diagrams, timelines or charts when needed

* Adapt designs for the dimensions and requirements of each platform

* Maintain consistency across fonts, colors and design elements

* Make revisions based on feedback and post-performance learnings



I’m particularly interested in someone who understands how to use contrast, pacing and visual variety across slides to keep the reader engaged.



## What I’m looking for



* Proven experience designing social media carousels

* A strong portfolio showing LinkedIn or Instagram content

* Excellent typography and layout skills

* Strong understanding of visual hierarchy

* Ability to communicate complex ideas simply

* Experience creating designs for personal brands, founders or creators

* Good instinct for hooks, storytelling and audience attention

* Ability to work with personal photos and limited visual assets

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication and turnaround times

* Openness to feedback and experimentation



Experience with startup, business, technology or educational content is a strong advantage.



## Tools



You should be comfortable working in one or more of the following:



* Figma

* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe Photoshop

* Canva

* Adobe InDesign



Please mention your preferred design software in your application.



All final designs should be delivered as platform-ready files, along with editable source files.



Over time, I would like the designer to identify which covers, layouts, visual formats and storytelling structures perform best and help turn them into repeatable templates.



## Expected workflow



I will usually provide:



* The carousel copy or rough draft

* The intended slide structure

* Personal photos or screenshots

* Brand references

* Examples of styles I like

* Notes about the purpose of the post



You will be responsible for turning these materials into a complete, polished carousel.



You should also feel comfortable suggesting when:



* A slide contains too much text

* The cover hook is visually weak

* A carousel needs to be shortened

* A concept could be explained more clearly through a diagram

* An image or layout change could improve retention



The initial volume will be approximately  5 carrousels a week



Most carousels will contain approximately 6–10 slides, although the length may vary depending on the story.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio

3. Three examples of social media carousels you have designed

4. Examples of work for founders, creators or personal brands, if available

5. Your rate per carousel or monthly package

6. What is included in your standard rate

7. Your typical turnaround time

8. The design tools you use

9. How many revision rounds are included

10. A short explanation of what makes someone continue swiping through a carousel



Please begin your application with the word “SWIPE”  so I know you have read the complete description.



Shortlisted designers may be invited to complete a paid trial carousel using the same copy and visual materials.



The trial will be evaluated based on:



* Cover-slide strength

* Typography

* Visual hierarchy

* Storytelling flow

* Brand fit

* Mobile readability

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions



## Compensation



Compensation may be structured as:



* A fixed fee per carousel

* A monthly package for a defined number of carousels

* An ongoing freelance retainer



Please include your preferred pricing structure and clearly explain what is included in your rate.

title: Senior Wedding Film Editor – DaVinci Resolve (Story-Led)
description:
Moody Imagery is an Australian wedding studio. Our films are NOT highlight reels — they're story-driven films that show who a couple truly are. We're looking for a senior editor who can take a wedding from raw footage to a finished, cinematic, emotional film, start to finish.



IMPORTANT: You must be an expert in DaVinci Resolve. This is our platform — edit page, colour, and Fairlight sound design. Please do NOT apply if your primary tool is Premiere or Final Cut.



HOW WE EDIT:

• We build the story with sound FIRST, visuals second — vows, ceremony 
nts, speeches, and natural laughter form the backbone; visuals prove and support the sound bites

• Films follow an emotional arc: Energy ? Intimacy ? Meaning ? Connection ? Celebration (not a chronological recap)

• Footage is chosen in this priority: emotion ? interaction between people ? story 
nts ? atmosphere ? detail

• Pacing must evolve across the film — never one rhythm throughout

• Films should feel like a warm, nostalgic memory, not a generic highlight reel



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Build the full story edit and emotional arc from culled selects

• Music selection and timing

• Colour grade (warm, filmic, nostalgic)

• Immersive sound design — ambience, laughter, environmental sound

• Deliver finished films on time, consistently



YOU MUST HAVE:

• Expert-level DaVinci Resolve skills (editing, colour, sound)

• A strong storytelling instinct — you can feel where a film needs to breathe

• Excellent written English and communication

• Fast, reliable internet for large video file transfer

• Reliability with deadlines — this matters as much as the craft



HOW TO APPLY: Start your reply with the word "RESOLVE" so we know you read this. Send (1) your showreel or 2–3 FULL wedding films (not just highlight snippets — we want to see how you hold a story across a whole film), (2) confirmation that DaVinci Resolve is your primary tool, and (3) a few lines about a film you're proud of and the storytelling choice behind it. Shortlisted editors will be PAID to complete a short story-edit test: we'll send culled selects from one wedding and ask you to build the arc, grade, and sound-design a short film from it.

title: Post Production Virtual Assistant
description:
IMPORTANT: We will only consider applicants WHO COMPLETE THE NOTION APPLICATION FORM linked below. Please DO NOT reply or apply through this posting, as applications submitted here will NOT be reviewed.



Schedule

- Full-time

- Monday to Friday

- 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST (Fixed)



---------------------------------------------------------

About Moon Media



We're a fast-growing creative agency that helps brands dominate short-form content. Our clients include companies with millions of followers, and our systems power the production and management of hundreds of videos every month.



But we're not just producing content.



We're building scalable systems that allow our creative team to produce high-quality content efficiently while giving our editors the time and focus they need to do their best work.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for a highly organized **Post-Production VA** to become the operational backbone of our post-production department.



This isn't a video editing role.



Instead, you'll be responsible for keeping our post-production workflow organized, accurate, and running smoothly through coordination, reporting, documentation, and workflow management. You'll work closely with our Lead Editor and Head of Operations to ensure everyone has the information, priorities, and systems they need to succeed.



If you enjoy organizing complex workflows, improving systems, and being the person who keeps everything running behind the scenes, we'd love to meet you.



---------------------------------------------------------

The Role



As our **Post-Production VA**, you'll support our Lead Editor by managing the day-to-day operations surrounding post-production.



You'll maintain our Notion systems, monitor production progress, coordinate with editors, prepare reports, document workflows, and help leadership stay informed without requiring constant manual follow-ups.



Over time, you'll also learn to assist with scriptwriting, production briefs, AI-assisted reporting, and workflow improvements as you become more familiar with our production process.



This role is ideal for someone who loves organization, enjoys solving operational problems, and wants to grow into a key operations role within a creative company.



---------------------------------------------------------

Responsibilities

- Keep video statuses, priorities, assignments, and workflow stages accurate.

- Monitor the production pipeline and identify stalled or missing work.

- Track editor productivity and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

- Monitor production priorities and expedite urgent requests when needed.

- Coordinate routine updates between editors, Operations, and the Lead Editor.

- Follow up on missing information, overdue tasks, and workflow blockers.

- Help leadership stay organized by preparing summaries, reminders, and production updates.



Documentation & Systems

- Build and maintain SOPs and workflow documentation.

- Create onboarding documentation for future tea
mbers.

- Help improve workflows as the company continues to scale.



Performance & Research

- Organize creative references and content examples for future production.

- Prepare recurring reports highlighting content trends and creative wins.



Production Support

As you grow into the role, you'll also receive training to:

- Assist with short-form scriptwriting.

- Prepare production briefs.

- Support content research.

- Use AI tools for reporting, documentation, and operational improvements.



---------------------------------------------------------

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

- STRONG NOTION SKILLS. You should be comfortable using databases, linked databases, templates, filtered views, dashboards, and workflow management.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Excellent communication and follow-up skills.

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable learning and using AI tools as part of your daily work.

- Able to work independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy.



---------------------------------------------------------

Nice to Have
